original: oṃ ganṅgāpathikacaṇḍālavidūragamanotsukāya namaḥ | oṃ dehātmabhramanirhāricaṇḍālavacanādṛtāya namaḥ | oṃ caṇḍālākāraviśveśapraśnānupraśnaharṣitāya namaḥ | oṃ manīṣāpañcakastotranirmāṇanipuṇāya namaḥ | oṃ mahate namaḥ | oṃ nijarūpasamāyuktacandracūḍāladarśakāya namaḥ | oṃ taddarśanasamāhlādanirvṛtātmane namaḥ | oṃ nirāmayāya namaḥ |
analyzed: om ganṅgā pathika caṇḍāla vidūra gamana utsukāya namaḥ om deha ātma bhrama nirhāri caṇḍāla vacana ādṛtāya namaḥ om caṇḍāla ākāra viśveśa praśna anupraśna harṣitāya namaḥ om manīṣā pañcaka stotra nirmāṇa nipuṇāya namaḥ om mahate namaḥ om nija rūpa samāyukta candra cūḍāla darśakāya namaḥ om tad darśana samāhlāda nirvṛta ātmane namaḥ om nirāmayāya namaḥ

original: oṃ nirākārāya namaḥ ||150|| oṃ nirātaṅkāya namaḥ | oṃ nirmamāya namaḥ | oṃ nirguṇāya namaḥ | oṃ vibhave namaḥ | oṃ nityatṛptāya namaḥ | oṃ nijānandāya namaḥ | oṃ nirāvaraṇāya namaḥ | oṃ īśvarāya namaḥ | oṃ nityaśuddhāya namaḥ | oṃ nityabuddhāya namaḥ ||160|| oṃ nityabodhaghanātmakāya namaḥ | oṃ īśaprasādabharitāya namaḥ |
analyzed: om nirākārāya namaḥ om nirātaṅkāya namaḥ om nirmamāya namaḥ om nirguṇāya namaḥ om vibhave namaḥ om nitya tṛptāya namaḥ om nija ānandāya namaḥ om nirāvaraṇāya namaḥ om īśvarāya namaḥ om nitya śuddhāya namaḥ om nitya buddhāya namaḥ om nitya bodha ghana ātmakāya namaḥ om īśa prasāda bharitāya namaḥ

original: oṃ īśvarārādhanotsukāya namaḥ | oṃ vedāntasūtrasadbhāṣyakaraṇapreritāya namaḥ | oṃ prabhave namaḥ | oṃ iśvarājñānusaraṇapariniścitamānasāya namaḥ | oṃ īśāntardhānasaṃdarśine namaḥ | oṃ vismayaspharitekṣaṇāya namaḥ | oṃ jāhnavītaṭinīsnānapavitrataramūrtikāya namaḥ | oṃ āhnikānantadhyātagurupādasaroruhāya namaḥ ||170||
analyzed: om īśvara ārādhana utsukāya namaḥ om vedānta sūtra sat bhāṣya karaṇa preritāya namaḥ om prabhave namaḥ om iśvara ājñā anusaraṇa pariniścita mānasāya namaḥ om īśa antardhāna saṃdarśiṇe namaḥ om vismaya spharita īkṣaṇāya namaḥ om jāhnavī taṭinī snāna pavitratara mūrtikāya namaḥ om āhnika ananta dhyāta guru pāda saroruhāya namaḥ

original: oṃ śrutiyuktisvānubhūtisāmarasyavicāraṇāya namaḥ | oṃ lokānugrahaṇaikāntapravaṇasvāntasaṃyutāya namaḥ | oṃ viśveśānugrahāvāptabhāṣyagrathananaipuṇāya namaḥ | oṃ tyaktakāśīpurīvāsāya namaḥ | oṃ badaryāśramacintakāya namaḥ | oṃ tatratyamunisandohasaṃbhāṣaṇasunirvṛtāya namaḥ | oṃ nānātīrthakṛtasnānāya namaḥ | oṃ mārgagāmine namaḥ |
analyzed: om śruti yukti sva anubhūti sāmarasya vicāraṇāya namaḥ om loka anugrahaṇa ekānta pravaṇa sva anta saṃyutāya namaḥ om viśveśa anugraha avāpta bhāṣya grathana naipuṇāya namaḥ om tyakta kāśī purī vāsāya namaḥ om badaryāśrama cintakāya namaḥ om tatratya muni sandoha saṃbhāṣaṇa su nirvṛtāya namaḥ om nānā tīrtha kṛta snānāya namaḥ om mārga gāmine namaḥ

original: oṃ manoharāya namaḥ | oṃ badaryāśramasaṃdarśanānandodrekasaṃyutāya namaḥ ||180|| oṃ karabilvīphalībhūtaparamādvaitatatvakāya namaḥ | oṃ unmattakajaganmohanivāraṇavicakṣaṇāya namaḥ | oṃ prasannagambhīramāhābhāṣyanirmāṇakautukine namaḥ | oṃ śrīmate namaḥ | oṃ upaniṣadbhāṣyagrathanaprathanotsukāya namaḥ |
analyzed: om manoharāya namaḥ om badarī āśrama saṃdarśana ānanda udreka saṃyutāya namaḥ om kara bilvī phalībhūta parama advaita tatvakāya namaḥ om unmattaka jagat moha nivāraṇa vicakṣaṇāya namaḥ om prasanna gambhīra māhābhāṣya nirmāṇa kautukine namaḥ om śrīmate namaḥ om upaniṣad bhāṣya grathana prathana utsukāya namaḥ

original: oṃ gītābhāṣyāmṛtāsārasantoṣitajagattrayāya namaḥ | oṃ śrīmatsanatsujātīyamukhagranthanibandhakāya namaḥ | oṃ nṛsiṃhatāpanīyādibhāṣyoddhārakṛtādarāya namaḥ | oṃ asaṃkhyagranthanirmātre namaḥ | oṃ lokānugrahakṛte namaḥ ||190|| oṃ sudhiye namaḥ | oṃ sūtrabhāṣyamahāyuktikhaṇḍitākhiladurmatāya namaḥ |
analyzed: om gītā bhāṣya amṛta āsāra santoṣita jagattrayāya namaḥ om śrīmat sanatsujātīya mukha grantha nibandhakāya namaḥ om nṛsiṃha tāpanīya ādi bhāṣya uddhāra kṛta ādarāya namaḥ om asaṃkhya grantha nirmātre namaḥ om loka anugraha kṛte namaḥ om sudhiye namaḥ om sūtra bhāṣya mahā yukti khaṇḍita akhila durmatāya namaḥ

original: oṃ bhāṣyāntarāndhakāraughanivāraṇadivākarāya namaḥ | oṃ svakṛtāśeṣabhāṣyādigranthādhyāpanatatparāya namaḥ | oṃ śāntidāntyādisaṃyuktaśiṣyamaṇḍalamaṇḍitāya namaḥ | oṃ sanandanādisacchiṣyanityādhītasvabhāṣyakāya namaḥ | oṃ triradhītātmabhāṣyaśrīsanandanasamāśritāya namaḥ | oṃ jāhnavīparatīrasthasanandanasamāhvāyine namaḥ |
analyzed: om bhāṣya antara andhakāra ogha nivāraṇa divākarāya namaḥ om sva kṛta aśeṣa bhāṣya ādi grantha adhyāpana tatparāya namaḥ om śānti dānti ādi saṃyukta śiṣya maṇḍala maṇḍitāya namaḥ om sanandana ādi sat śiṣya nitya adhīta sva bhāṣyakāya namaḥ om tris adhīta ātma bhāṣya śrī sanandana samāśritāya namaḥ om jāhnavī para tīra stha sanandana samāhvāyine namaḥ

original: oṃ gaṅgotthakamalavrātadvārāyātasanandanāya namaḥ | oṃ ācāryabhaktimāhātmyanidarśanaparāyaṇāya namaḥ ||200|| oṃ ānandamantharasvāntasanandanakṛtānataye namaḥ | oṃ tadīyāśleṣasuhitāya namaḥ | oṃ sādhumārganidarśakāya namaḥ | oṃ dattapadmapadābhikhyāya namaḥ | oṃ bhāṣyādhyāpanatatparāya namaḥ | oṃ tattatsthalasamāyātapaṇḍitākṣepakhaṇḍakāya namaḥ |
analyzed: om gaṅgā uttha kamala vrāta dvāra āyāta sanandanāya namaḥ om ācārya bhakti māhātmya nidarśana parāyaṇāya namaḥ om ānanda manthara svānta sanandana kṛta ānataye namaḥ om tadīya āśleṣa suhitāya namaḥ om sādhu mārga nidarśakāya namaḥ om datta padma pada abhikhyāya namaḥ om bhāṣya adhyāpana tatparāya namaḥ om tad tad sthala samāyāta paṇḍita ākṣepa khaṇḍakāya namaḥ

original: oṃ nānākumatadurdhvāntadhvaṃsanodyatamānasāya namaḥ | oṃ dhīmate namaḥ | oṃ advaitasiddhāntasamarthanasamutsukāya namaḥ | oṃ vedāntamahāraṇyamadhyasañcārakesariṇe namaḥ ||210|| oṃ trayyantanalinībhṛṅgāya namaḥ | oṃ trayyantāmbhojabhāskarāya namaḥ | oṃ advaitāmṛtamādhuryasarvasvānubhavodyatāya namaḥ | oṃ advaitamārgasantrātre namaḥ |
analyzed: om nānā kumata durdhvānta dhvaṃsana udyata mānasāya namaḥ om dhīmate namaḥ om advaita siddhānta samarthana samutsukāya namaḥ om vedānta mahā araṇya madhya sañcāra kesariṇe namaḥ om trayī anta nalinī bhṛṅgāya namaḥ om trayī anta ambhoja bhāskarāya namaḥ om advaita amṛta mādhurya sarva sva anubhava udyatāya namaḥ om advaita mārga santrātre namaḥ

original: oṃ nirdvaitabrahmacintakāya namaḥ | oṃ dvaitāraṇyasamucchedakuṭhārāya namaḥ | oṃ niḥsapatnakāya namaḥ | oṃ śrautasmārtādhvanīnānugrahaṇaihaparāyaṇāya namaḥ | oṃ vāvadūkabudhavrātavisthāpanamahāvacase namaḥ | oṃ svīyavāgvaikharīlīlāvismāpitabudhavrajāya namaḥ ||220|| oṃ ślāghāsahasrasaṃśrotre namaḥ | oṃ nirvikārāya namaḥ | oṃ guṇākarāya namaḥ |
analyzed: om nirdvaita brahma cintakāya namaḥ om dvaita araṇya samuccheda kuṭhārāya namaḥ om niḥsapatnakāya namaḥ om śrauta smārta adhvanīna anugrahaṇa eha parāyaṇāya namaḥ om vāvadūka budha vrāta visthāpana mahā vacase namaḥ om svīya vāc vaikharī līlā vismāpita budha vrajāya namaḥ om ślāghā sahasra saṃśrotre namaḥ om nirvikārāya namaḥ om guṇa ākarāya namaḥ

original: oṃ trayyantasārasarvasvasaṅgrahaikaparāyaṇāya namaḥ | oṃ trayyantagūḍhaparamātmākhyaratnoddhṛtikṣamāya namaḥ | oṃ trayyantabhāṣyaśītāṃśuviśadīkṛtabhūtalāya namaḥ | oṃ gaṅgāpravāhasadṛśasūktisārāya namaḥ | oṃ mahāśāyāya namaḥ | oṃ vitaṇḍikākhyavetaṇḍakhaṇḍādbhutapaṇḍitāya namaḥ | oṃ bhāṣyapracāraniratāya namaḥ ||230||
analyzed: om trayī anta sāra sarva sva saṅgraha eka parāyaṇāya namaḥ om trayī anta gūḍha paramātma ākhya ratna uddhṛti kṣamāya namaḥ om trayī anta bhāṣya śītāṃśu viśadīkṛta bhū talāya namaḥ om gaṅgā pravāha sadṛśa su ukti sārāya namaḥ om mahāśāyāya namaḥ om vitaṇḍika ākhya vetaṇḍa khaṇḍa adbhuta paṇḍitāya namaḥ om bhāṣya pracāra niratāya namaḥ

original: oṃ bhāṣyapravacanotsukāya namaḥ | oṃ bhāṣyāmṛtābdhimathanasaṃpannajñānasārabhāje namaḥ | oṃ bhāṣyasāragrahāsaktabhaktamuktipradāyakāya namaḥ | oṃ bhāṣyākārayaśorāśipavitritajagattrayāya namaḥ | oṃ bhāṣyāmṛtāsvādalubdhakarmandijanasevitāya namaḥ | oṃ bhāṣyaratnaprabhājāladedīpitajagattrayāya namaḥ |
analyzed: om bhāṣya pravacana utsukāya namaḥ om bhāṣya amṛta abdhi mathana saṃpanna jñāna sāra bhāje namaḥ om bhāṣya sāra graha āsakta bhakta mukti pradāyakāya namaḥ om bhāṣya ākāra yaśas rāśi pavitrita jagattrayāya namaḥ om bhāṣya amṛta āsvāda lubdha karmandi jana sevitāya namaḥ om bhāṣya ratna prabhā jāla dedīpita jagattrayāya namaḥ

original: oṃ bhāṣyagaṅgājalasnātaniḥśeṣakaluṣāpahāyāya namaḥ | oṃ bhāṣyagāmbhīryasaṃdraṣṭṛjanavismayakārakāya namaḥ | oṃ bhāṣyāmbhonidhinirmagnabhaktakaivalyadāyakāya namaḥ | oṃ bhāṣyacandrodayollāsavidvastadhvāntadakṣiṇāya namaḥ | oṃ bhāṣyākhyakumudavrātavikāsanasucandramase namaḥ | oṃ bhāṣyayuktikuṭhāraughanikṛttadvaitadurdrumāya namaḥ |
analyzed: om bhāṣya gaṅgā jala snāta niḥśeṣa kaluṣa apahāyāya namaḥ om bhāṣya gāmbhīrya saṃdraṣṭṛ jana vismaya kārakāya namaḥ om bhāṣya ambhonidhi nirmagna bhakta kaivalya dāyakāya namaḥ om bhāṣya candra udaya ullāsa vidvasta dhvānta dakṣiṇāya namaḥ om bhāṣya ākhya kumuda vrāta vikāsana su candramase namaḥ om bhāṣya yukti kuṭhāra ogha nikṛtta dvaita durdrumāya namaḥ

original: oṃ bhāṣyāmṛtābdhilaharīvihārāparikhinnadhiye namaḥ | oṃ bhāṣyasiddhāntasarvasvapeṭikāyitamānasāya namaḥ | oṃ bhāṣyākhyanikaṣagrāvaśodhitādvaitakāñcanāya namaḥ | oṃ bhāṣyavaipulyagāmbhīryatiraskṛtapayonidhaye namaḥ | oṃ bhāṣyābhidhasudhāvṛṣṭipariplāvitabhūtalāya namaḥ | oṃ bhāṣyapīyūṣavarṣonmūlitasaṃtāpasantataye namaḥ |
analyzed: om bhāṣya amṛta abdhi lahari vihāra a parikhinna dhiye namaḥ om bhāṣya siddhānta sarva sva peṭikāyita mānasāya namaḥ om bhāṣya ākhya nikaṣa grāva śodhita advaita kāñcanāya namaḥ om bhāṣya vaipulya gāmbhīrya tiraskṛta payonidhaye namaḥ om bhāṣya abhidha sudhā vṛṣṭi pariplāvita bhū talāya namaḥ om bhāṣya pīyūṣa varṣa unmūlita saṃtāpa santataye namaḥ

original: oṃ bhāṣyatantupariprotasadyuktikusumāvalaye namaḥ ||250|| oṃ vedāntavedyavibhavāya namaḥ | oṃ vedāntapariniṣṭhitāya namaḥ | oṃ vedāntavākyanivahāyārthyaparicintakāya namaḥ | oṃ vedāntavākyavilasaddaidamparyapradarśakāya namaḥ | oṃ vedāntavākyapīyūṣasyādimābhijñamānasāya namaḥ | oṃ vedāntavākyakusumarasāsvādanabambharāya namaḥ |
analyzed: om namaḥ om vedānta vedya vibhavāya namaḥ om vedānta pariniṣṭhitāya namaḥ om vedānta vākya nivahāya arthya paricintakāya namaḥ om vedānta vākya vilasat daidamparya pradarśakāya namaḥ om vedānta vākya pīyūṣasya ādima abhijña mānasāya namaḥ om vedānta vākya kusuma rasa āsvādana bambharāya namaḥ

original: oṃ vedāntasārasarvasvanidhānāyitacittabhuve namaḥ | oṃ vedāntanalinīhaṃsāya namaḥ | oṃ vedāntāmbhojabhāskarāya namaḥ | oṃ vedāntakumudollāsasudhānidhaye namaḥ ||260|| oṃ udāradhiye namaḥ | oṃ vedāntaśāstrasāhāyyaparājitakuvādikāya namaḥ | oṃ vedāntāmbodhilaharīvihāraparinirvṛtāya namaḥ | oṃ śiṣyaśaṅkāparicchetre namaḥ |
analyzed: om vedānta sāra sarvasva nidhāna āyita citta bhuve namaḥ om vedānta nalinī haṃsāya namaḥ om vedānta ambhoja bhāskarāya namaḥ om vedānta kumuda ullāsa sudhā nidhaye namaḥ om udāra dhiye namaḥ om vedānta śāstra sāhāyya parājita ku vādikāya namaḥ om vedānta ambodhi laharī vihāra parinirvṛtāya namaḥ om śiṣya śaṅkā paricchetre namaḥ

original: oṃ śiṣyādhyāpanatatparāya namaḥ | oṃ vṛddhaveṣapraticchannavyāsācāryāvalokanāya namaḥ | oṃ adhyāpyamānaviṣayajijñāsuvyāsacoditāya namaḥ | oṃ śiṣyaughavarṇitasvīyamāhātmyāya namaḥ | oṃ mahimākarāya namaḥ | oṃ svasūtrabhāṣyaśravaṇasaṃtuṣṭavyāsananditāya namaḥ ||270|| oṃ pṛṣṭasūtrārthakāya namaḥ | oṃ vāgmine namaḥ | oṃ vinayojvalamānasāya namaḥ |
analyzed: om śiṣya adhyāpana tatparāya namaḥ om vṛddha veṣa praticchanna vyāsa ācārya avalokanāya namaḥ om adhyāpyamāna viṣaya jijñāsu vyāsa coditāya namaḥ om śiṣya ogha varṇita svīya māhātmyāya namaḥ om mahima ākarāya namaḥ om sva sūtra bhāṣya śravaṇa saṃtuṣṭa vyāsa nanditāya namaḥ om pṛṣṭa sūtra arthakāya namaḥ om vāgmine namaḥ om vinaya ujvala mānasāya namaḥ

original: oṃ tadantaretyādisūtrapraśnaharṣitamānasāya namaḥ | oṃ śrutyupodbalitasvīyavacorañjitabhūsurāya namaḥ | oṃ bhūtasūkṣmopasṛṣṭajīvātmagatisādhakāya namaḥ | oṃ tāṇḍiśrutigatapraśnottaravākyanidarśakāya namaḥ | oṃ śatadhākalpitasvīyapakṣāya namaḥ | oṃ sarvasamādhikṛte namaḥ | oṃ vāvadūkamahāvipraparamāścaryadāyakāya namaḥ ||280||
analyzed: om tad antarā ityādi sūtra praśna harṣita mānasāya namaḥ om śruti upodbalita svīya vacaḥ rañjita bhūsurāya namaḥ om bhūta sūkṣma upasṛṣṭa jīva ātma gati sādhakāya namaḥ om tāṇḍi śruti gata praśna uttara vākya nidarśakāya namaḥ om śatadhā kalpita svīya pakṣāya namaḥ om sarva samādhi kṛte namaḥ om vāvadūka mahā vipra parama āścarya dāyakāya namaḥ

original: oṃ tattatpraśnasamādhānasantoṣitamahāmunaye namaḥ | oṃ vedāvasānavākyaughasāmarasyakṛte namaḥ | oṃ avyayāya namaḥ | oṃ dināṣṭakakṛtāsaṃkhyavādāya namaḥ | oṃ vijayabhājanāya namaḥ | oṃ vismayānandabharitaśrotṛślāghitavaibhavāya namaḥ | oṃ viṣṇuśaṅkaratāvācipadmāṅghripratibodhitāaya namaḥ | oṃ padmāṅghriprārthitasvīyavāgvyapāravirāmakāya namaḥ |
analyzed: om tad tad praśna samādhāna santoṣita mahā munaye namaḥ om veda avasāna vākya ogha sāmarasya kṛte namaḥ om avyayāya namaḥ om dina aṣṭaka kṛta asaṃkhya vādāya namaḥ om vijaya bhājanāya namaḥ om vismaya ānanda bharita śrotṛ ślāghita vaibhavāya namaḥ om viṣṇu śaṅkara tā vāci padmāṅghri namaḥ om namaḥ om padmāṅghri prārthita svīya vāgvya pāra virāmakāya namaḥ

original: oṃ tadīyavākyasārajñāya namaḥ | oṃ namaskārasamudyatāya namaḥ | oṃ vyāsamāhātmyavijñātre namaḥ | oṃ vyāsastutiparāyaṇāya namaḥ | oṃ nānāpadyāvalīprītavyāsānugrahabhājanāya namaḥ | oṃ nijarūpasamāyuktavyāsasaṃdarśanotsukāya namaḥ | oṃ tāpicchamañjarīkāntavyāsavigrahadarśakāya namaḥ | oṃ śiṣyāvalīparivṛtāya namaḥ | oṃ pratyudgatividhāyakāya namaḥ |
analyzed: om tadīya vākya sāra jñāya namaḥ om namaskāra samudyatāya namaḥ om vyāsa māhātmya vijñātre namaḥ om vyāsa stuti parāyaṇāya namaḥ om nānāpadya āvalī prīta vyāsa anugraha bhājanāya namaḥ om nija rūpa samāyukta vyāsa saṃdarśana utsukāya namaḥ om tāpiccha mañjarī kānta vyāsa vigraha darśakāya namaḥ om śiṣya āvalī parivṛtāya namaḥ om pratyudgati vidhāyakāya namaḥ

original: oṃ svīyāparādhaśamanasamabhyarthanatatparāya namaḥ | oṃ bādarāyaṇapādābjayugalīsparśanodyatāya namaḥ ||300|| oṃ vyāsadarśanajasvīyakārtārthyapratipādakāya namaḥ | oṃ aṣṭādaśapurāṇaughaduṣkaratvanibodhakāya namaḥ | oṃ tattādṛśapurāṇaughanirmātṛtvābhinandakāya namaḥ | oṃ paropakāranairatyaślāghakāya namaḥ | oṃ vyāsapūjakāya namaḥ |
analyzed: om svīya aparādha śamana samabhyarthana tatparāya namaḥ om bādarāyaṇa pāda abja yugalī sparśana udyatāya namaḥ om vyāsa darśana ja svīya kārtārthya pratipādakāya namaḥ om aṣṭādaśa purāṇa ogha duṣkara tva nibodhakāya namaḥ om tad tādṛśa purāṇa ogha nirmātṛ tva abhinandakāya namaḥ om para upakāra nairatya ślāghakāya namaḥ om vyāsa pūjakāya namaḥ

original: oṃ bhinnaśākhācaturvedavibhāgaślāghakāya namaḥ | oṃ mahate namaḥ | oṃ kalikālīnamandātmānugrahītṛtvapradarśakāya namaḥ | oṃ nānāprabandhakartṛtvajanitāścaryabodhakāya namaḥ | oṃ bhāratākhyamahāgranthaduṣkaratvapradarśakāya namaḥ ||310|| oṃ nārāyaṇāvatāratvapradarśine namaḥ | oṃ prārthanodyatāya namaḥ |
analyzed: om bhinna śākhā catur veda vibhāga ślāghakāya namaḥ om mahate namaḥ om kali kālīna manda ātma anugrahītṛ tva pradarśakāya namaḥ om nānā prabandha kartṛ tva janita āścarya bodhakāya namaḥ om bhārata ākhya mahā grantha duṣkara tva pradarśakāya namaḥ om nārāyaṇa avatāra tva pradarśiṇe namaḥ om prārthanā udyatāya namaḥ

original: oṃ svānugrahaikaphalakavyāsāgamanaśamsakāya namaḥ | oṃ svakīyabhāṣyālokārthavyāsasaṃprārthakāya namaḥ | oṃ munaye namaḥ | oṃ nijabhāṣyagagāmbhīryavismāpitamahāmunaye namaḥ | oṃ bhāṣyasarvāṃśasaṃdraṣṭṛvyāsācāryābhinanditāya namaḥ | oṃ nijasiddhāntasarvasvadraṣṭṛvyāsābhipūjitāya namaḥ | oṃ śrutisūtrasusāṅgatyasaṃdraṣṭṛvyāsapūjitāya namaḥ |
analyzed: om sva anugraha eka phalaka vyāsa āgamana śamsakāya namaḥ om svakīya bhāṣya āloka artha vyāsa saṃprārthakāya namaḥ om munaye namaḥ om nija bhāṣya ga gāmbhīrya vismāpita mahā munaye namaḥ om bhāṣya sarva aṃśa saṃdraṣṭṛ vyāsa ācārya abhinanditāya namaḥ om nija siddhānta sarva sva draṣṭṛ vyāsa abhipūjitāya namaḥ om śruti sūtra su sāṅgatya saṃdraṣṭṛ vyāsa pūjitāya namaḥ

original: oṃ ślāghāvādasahasraikapātrabhūtāya namaḥ ||320|| oṃ mahāmunaye namaḥ | oṃ govindayogīśiṣyatvaślāghakavyāsapūjitāya namaḥ | oṃ svaśaṅkarramśatāvādivyāsavākyānumodakāya namaḥ | oṃ vyāsāśayāviṣkaraṇabhāṣyaprathanatatparāya namaḥ | oṃ sarvasaubhāgyanilayāya namaḥ | oṃ sarvasaukhyapradāyakāya namaḥ | oṃ sarvajñāya namaḥ | oṃ sarvadṛśe namaḥ |
analyzed: om ślāghā vāda sahasra eka pātra bhūtāya namaḥ om mahā munaye namaḥ om govinda yogī śiṣya tva ślāghaka vyāsa pūjitāya namaḥ om sva śaṅkar raṃśatā vādi vyāsa vākya anumodakāya namaḥ om vyāsa āśaya āviṣkaraṇa bhāṣya prathana tatparāya namaḥ om sarva saubhāgya nilayāya namaḥ om sarva saukhya pradāyakāya namaḥ om sarvajñāya namaḥ om sarva dṛśe namaḥ

original: oṃ sākṣiṇe namaḥ | oṃ sarvatomukhanaipuṇyāya namaḥ ||330|| oṃ sarvakartre namaḥ | oṃ sarvagoptre namaḥ | oṃ sarvavaibhavasaṃyutāya namaḥ | oṃ sarvabhāvaviśeṣajñāya namaḥ | oṃ sarvaśāstraviśāradāya namaḥ | oṃ sarvābhīṣṭapradāya namaḥ | oṃ devāya namaḥ | oṃ sarvaduḥkhanivāraṇāya namaḥ | oṃ sarvasaṃśayavicchetre namaḥ |
analyzed: om sākṣiṇe namaḥ om sarvatomukha naipuṇyāya namaḥ om sarva kartre namaḥ om sarva goptre namaḥ om sarva vaibhava saṃyutāya namaḥ om sarva bhāva viśeṣa jñāya namaḥ om sarva śāstra viśāradāya namaḥ om sarva abhīṣṭa pradāya namaḥ om devāya namaḥ om sarva duḥkha nivāraṇāya namaḥ om sarva saṃśaya vicchetre namaḥ

original: oṃ sarvasampatpradāyakāya namaḥ ||340|| oṃ sarvasaukhyavidhātre namaḥ | oṃ sarvāmarakṛtānataye namaḥ | oṃ sarvarṣigaṇasampūjyāya namaḥ | oṃ sarvamaṅgalakāraṇāya namaḥ | oṃ sarvaduḥkhāpahāya namaḥ | oṃ saumyāya namaḥ | oṃ sarvāntaryamaṇāya namaḥ | oṃ baline namaḥ | oṃ sarvādhārāya namaḥ | oṃ sarvagāmine namaḥ ||350||
analyzed: om sarva sampad pradāyakāya namaḥ om sarva saukhya vidhātre namaḥ om sarva amara kṛta ānataye namaḥ om sarva ṛṣi gaṇa sampūjyāya namaḥ om sarva maṅgala kāraṇāya namaḥ om sarva duḥkha apahāya namaḥ om saumyāya namaḥ om sarva antar yamaṇāya namaḥ om baline namaḥ om sarva ādhārāya namaḥ om sarva gāmine namaḥ

original: oṃ sarvatobhadradāyakāya namaḥ | oṃ sarvadurvādidurgarvakharvīkaraṇakautikine namaḥ | oṃ sarvalokasuvikhyātayaśorāśaye namaḥ | oṃ amoghavāce namaḥ | oṃ sarvabhaktasamuddhartre namaḥ | oṃ sarvāpadvinivārakāya namaḥ | oṃ sārvabhaumādihairaṇyagarbhāntānandacintakāya namaḥ | oṃ bhūyogragranthanirmāṇakṛtavyāsāryacodanāya namaḥ |
analyzed: om sarvatobhadra dāyakāya namaḥ om sarva durvādi durgarva kharvīkaraṇa kautikine namaḥ om sarva loka su vikhyāta yaśas rāśaye namaḥ om amoghavāce namaḥ om sarva bhakta samuddhartre namaḥ om sarva āpad vinivārakāya namaḥ om sārvabhauma ādi hairaṇyagarbha anta ānanda cintakāya namaḥ om bhūya ugra grantha nirmāṇa kṛta vyāsa ārya codanāya namaḥ

original: oṃ bhedavādinirāśārthivyāsavākyānumodakāya namaḥ | oṃ yathāgatasvagamanabodhakavyāsacoditāya namaḥ ||360|| oṃ vedāntabhāṣyaracanapracārādivibodhakāya namaḥ | oṃ svakīyakṛtakṛtyatvabodhakāya namaḥ | oṃ prārthanāparāya namaḥ | oṃ maṇikarṇīmahākṣetravyāsasānidhyayācakāya namaḥ | oṃ ātmīyadehasaṃtyāgapravṛttāya namaḥ | oṃ vyāsacodakāya namaḥ |
analyzed: om bheda vādi nirāśa arthi vyāsa vākya anumodakāya namaḥ om yathāgata sva gamana bodhaka vyāsa coditāya namaḥ om vedānta bhāṣya racana pracāra ādi vibodhakāya namaḥ om svakīya kṛtakṛtyatva bodhakāya namaḥ om prārthanā parasmai namaḥ om maṇikarṇī mahā kṣetra vyāsa sānidhya yācakāya namaḥ om ātmīya deha saṃtyāga pravṛttāya namaḥ om vyāsa codakāya namaḥ

original: oṃ niṣiddhadehasaṃtyāgavyāsājñāparipālakāya namaḥ | oṃ anirjitānekavādijayasaṃpreritāya namaḥ | oṃ sukhine namaḥ | oṃ avatāramahākāryasampūrṇatvānucintakāya namaḥ ||370|| oṃ svasūtrabhāṣyamādhuryaprītavyāsakṛtādarāya namaḥ | oṃ varadānakṛtotsāhavyāsasamcoditāya namaḥ | oṃ kavaye namaḥ | oṃ vidhidattaṣṭasaṃkhyākavayase namaḥ |
analyzed: om niṣiddha deha saṃtyāga vyāsa ājñā paripālakāya namaḥ om anirjita aneka vādi jaya saṃpreritāya namaḥ om sukhine namaḥ om avatāra mahā kārya sampūrṇa tva anucintakāya namaḥ om kavaye namaḥ om namaḥ namaḥ

original: oṃ sannyāsasaṃgrahiṇe namaḥ | oṃ svavaidagdhyābhiniṣpannavayoṣṭakakṛtāśrayāya namaḥ | oṃ vyāsājñāvaibhavotpannaṣoḍaśābdāya namaḥ | oṃ śivaṅkarāya namaḥ | oṃ śrutisūtramahābhāṣyatriveṇyutpattibhuve namaḥ | oṃ śivāya namaḥ ||380|| oṃ vedavyāsapadāmbhojayugalīsparśanirvṛtāya namaḥ | oṃ bhaktigarbhitavākyaughakusumāñjalidāyakāya namaḥ |
analyzed: om sannyāsa saṃgrahiṇe namaḥ om sva vaidagdhya abhiniṣpanna vayoṣṭaka kṛta āśrayāya namaḥ om vyāsa ājñā vaibhava utpanna ṣoḍaśa abdāya namaḥ om śivaṅkarāya namaḥ om śruti sūtra mahā bhāṣya triveṇī utpatti bhuve namaḥ om śivāya namaḥ om vedavyāsa pada ambhoja yugalī sparśa nirvṛtāya namaḥ om bhakti garbhita vākya ogha kusumāñjali dāyakāya namaḥ

original: oṃ vyāsadattavaragrāhiṇe namaḥ | oṃ vyāsāntardhānadarśakāya namaḥ | oṃ bādarāyaṇaviśleṣavyasanāturamānasāya namaḥ | oṃ vyāsasaṃcoditāśeṣadigvijayaikakṛtodyamāya namaḥ | oṃ kumārilāvalokecchave namaḥ | oṃ dakṣiṇāśāgamodyatāya namaḥ | oṃ bhaṭṭapādāparābhikhyakumārilajayotsukāya namaḥ | oṃ prayāgagamanodyuktāya namaḥ ||390||
analyzed: om vyāsa datta vara grāhiṇe namaḥ om vyāsa antardhāna darśakāya namaḥ om bādarāyaṇa viśleṣa vyasana ātura mānasāya namaḥ om vyāsa saṃcodita aśeṣa diś vijaya eka kṛta udyamāya namaḥ om kumārila avaloka icchave namaḥ om dakṣiṇa āśā āgama udyatāya namaḥ om bhaṭṭa pāda apara abhikhya kumārila jaya utsukāya namaḥ om prayāga gamana udyuktāya namaḥ

original: oṃ triveṇīsaṅgamasnānapavitrataramūrtikāya namaḥ | oṃ gaṅgātuṅgataraṅgaughadarśanaprītamānasāya namaḥ | oṃ hṛdyānavadyapadyaughasaṃstutābhrasaridvarāya namaḥ | oṃ bhūyobhūyaḥkṛtasnānāya namaḥ | oṃ daṇḍālaṅkṛtahastakāya namaḥ | oṃ nānāghamarṣamantrānupāṭhakāya namaḥ | oṃ dhyānatatparāya namaḥ | oṃ nānāmantrajapaprītāya namaḥ |
analyzed: om triveṇī saṅgama snāna pavitratara mūrtikāya namaḥ om gaṅgā tuṅga taraṃga ogha darśana prīta mānasāya namaḥ om hṛdya anavadya padya ogha saṃstuta abhra sarit varāya namaḥ om bhūyas bhūyas kṛta snānāya namaḥ om daṇḍa alaṅkṛta hastakāya namaḥ om nānā aghamarṣa mantra anupāṭhakāya namaḥ om dhyāna tatparāya namaḥ om nānā mantra japa prītāya namaḥ

original: oṃ mantrasārajñāya namaḥ | oṃ uttamāya namaḥ ||400|| oṃ mantrārthavyākṛtikṣamāya namaḥ | oṃ mantramāṇikyamanjūṣāyitacetaḥpradeśakāya namaḥ | oṃ mantraratnākarāya namaḥ | oṃ mānine namaḥ | oṃ mantravaibhavadarśakāya namaḥ | oṃ mantraśāstrārthatatvajñāya namaḥ | oṃ mantraśāstrapravartakāya namaḥ | oṃ māntrikāgresarāya namaḥ ||410||
analyzed: om mantra sāra jñāya namaḥ om uttamāya namaḥ om mantra artha vyākṛti kṣamāya namaḥ om mantra māṇikya manjūṣāyita cetas pradeśakāya namaḥ om mantra ratna ākarāya namaḥ om mānine namaḥ om mantra vaibhava darśakāya namaḥ om mantra śāstra artha tatva jñāya namaḥ om mantra śāstra pravartakāya namaḥ om māntrika agresarāya namaḥ

original: oṃ mānyāya namaḥ | oṃ mantrāmbhoruhaṣaṭpadāya namaḥ | oṃ mantrakānanasañcārakesariṇe namaḥ | oṃ mantratatparāya namaḥ | oṃ mantrābhidhasukāsārakalahaṃsāya namaḥ | oṃ mahāmataye namaḥ | oṃ mantrasaṃśayavicchetre namaḥ | oṃ mantrajātopadeśakāya namaḥ | oṃ snānakālasamāyātamātṛsmṛtaye namaḥ | oṃ amoghadhiye namaḥ ||420||
analyzed: om mānyāya namaḥ om mantra ambhoruha ṣaṭpadāya namaḥ om mantra kānana sañcāra kesariṇe namaḥ om mantra tatparāya namaḥ om mantra abhidha su kāsāra kalahaṃsāya namaḥ om mahāmataye namaḥ om mantra saṃśaya vicchetre namaḥ om mantra jāta upadeśakāya namaḥ om snāna kāla samāyāta mātṛ smṛtaye namaḥ om amogha dhiye namaḥ

original: oṃ āhnikānuṣṭhitivyagrāya namaḥ | oṃ yatidharmaparāyaṇāya namaḥ | oṃ ekāntamataye namaḥ | oṃ ekāntaśīlāya namaḥ | oṃ ekāntasaṃśritāya namaḥ | oṃ bhaṭṭapādatuṣāṅgārāveśavṛttaniśāmakāya namaḥ | oṃ bhāṣyavārtikanirmāṇamanorathasamīritāya namaḥ | oṃ bhaṭṭapādīyavṛttāntapratyakṣīkaraṇotsukāya namaḥ | oṃ kumārilasamālokalālasāya namaḥ |
analyzed: om āhnika anuṣṭhiti vyagrāya namaḥ om yati dharma parāyaṇāya namaḥ om ekānta mataye namaḥ om ekānta śīlāya namaḥ om ekānta saṃśritāya namaḥ om bhaṭṭa pāda tuṣa aṅgāra āveśa vṛtta niśāmakāya namaḥ om bhāṣya vārtika nirmāṇa manoratha samīritāya namaḥ om bhaṭṭa pādīya vṛttānta pratyakṣīkaraṇa utsukāya namaḥ om kumārila samāloka lālasāya namaḥ

original: oṃ gamanotsukāya namaḥ ||430|| oṃ tuṣāgnirāśimadhyasthabhaṭṭapādāvalokanāya namaḥ | oṃ prabhākarādisacchiṣyāvṛtatanmūrtidarśakāya namaḥ | oṃ tuṣāgnisthitatadvaktraprasādālokavismitāya namaḥ | oṃ atarkitāgataprītabhaṭṭapādābhinanditāya namaḥ | oṃ bhaṭṭapādīyasacchiṣyakṛtanānopacārakāya namaḥ | oṃ antyakālasvasānidhyasantoṣitakumārilāya namaḥ |
analyzed: om gamana utsukāya namaḥ om tuṣa agni rāśi madhya stha bhaṭṭa pāda avalokanāya namaḥ om prabhākara ādi sat śiṣya āvṛta tad mūrti darśakāya namaḥ om tuṣa agni sthita tad vaktra prasāda āloka vismitāya namaḥ om atarkita āgata prīta bhaṭṭa pāda abhinanditāya namaḥ om bhaṭṭapādīya sat śiṣya kṛta nānā upacārakāya namaḥ om antya kāla svasā nidhya santoṣita kumārilāya namaḥ

original: oṃ nijadarśanasantuṣṭabhaṭṭapādābhinanditāya namaḥ | oṃ satsaṅgamanamāhatmyavādibhaṭṭābhipūjitāya namaḥ | oṃ saṃsārānityatāvācibhaṭṭaśokānuśocakāya namaḥ | oṃ kālānaiyyatyasaṃbodhibhaṭṭapādoktiśamsanāya namaḥ ||440|| oṃ īśāpahnavajātyantadoṣavādasusaṃśraviṇe namaḥ | oṃ bauddhāntevāsitābodhibhaṭṭavākyapraśamsakāya namaḥ |
analyzed: om nija darśana santuṣṭa bhaṭṭa pāda abhinanditāya namaḥ om sat saṅgamana māhatmya vādi bhaṭṭa abhipūjitāya namaḥ om saṃsāra anitya tā vāci bhaṭṭa śoka anuśocakāya namaḥ om kāla a naiyyatya saṃbodhi bhaṭṭa pāda ukti śamsanāya namaḥ om īśa apahnava jāti anta doṣa vāda su saṃśraviṇe namaḥ om bauddha antevāsi tā bodhi bhaṭṭa vākya praśamsakāya namaḥ

original: oṃ bhaṭṭapādīyasaudhāgrapatanākarṇanāturāya namaḥ | oṃ vedabhaktiprayuktyaitatkṣatābhāvaniśāmakāya namaḥ | oṃ ekacakṣuḥkṣataprāptiśocadbhaṭṭānuśocakāya namaḥ | oṃ gurudrohākhyaduritasambhavākarṇanāturāya namaḥ | oṃ prāyaścittārtharacitatuṣāgnyāveśadarśakāya namaḥ | oṃ svadarśanajakārtārthyabodhibhaṭṭoktipūjitāya namaḥ |
analyzed: om bhaṭṭapādīya saudha agra patana ākarṇana āturāya namaḥ om veda bhakti prayuktyā etad kṣata abhāva niśāmakāya namaḥ om eka cakṣuḥ kṣata prāpti śocat bhaṭṭa anuśocakāya namaḥ om guru droha ākhya durita sambhava ākarṇana āturāya namaḥ om prāyaścitta artha racita tuṣa agni āveśa darśakāya namaḥ om sva darśana ja kārtārthya bodhi bhaṭṭa ukti pūjitāya namaḥ

original: oṃ svabhāṣyavṛttiracanabhāgyābhāvoktisamśraviṇe namaḥ | oṃ tatprayuktayaśo'bhāvabodhibhaṭṭānuśocakāya namaḥ ||450|| oṃ nijāvatārābhijñaptibodhibhaṭṭoktiśamsanāya namaḥ | oṃ subrahmaṇyāvatāratvabodhakāya namaḥ | oṃ ślāghanāparāya namaḥ | oṃ karmakāṇḍapratiṣṭhārthatadīyāgamabodhakāya namaḥ | oṃ sādhumārgānuśikṣārthatadīyavratabodhakāya namaḥ |
analyzed: om sva bhāṣya vṛtti racana bhāgya abhāva ukti samśraviṇe namaḥ om tad prayukta yaśaḥ bhāva bodhi bhaṭṭa anuśocakāya namaḥ om nija avatāra abhijñapti bodhi bhaṭṭa ukti śamsanāya namaḥ om su brahmaṇya avatāra tva bodhakāya namaḥ om ślāghanā parasmai namaḥ om karmakāṇḍa pratiṣṭhā artha tadīya āgama bodhakāya namaḥ om sādhu mārga anuśikṣā artha tadīya vrata bodhakāya namaḥ

original: oṃ karakāmbukaṇāsekajīvanotsukamānasāya namaḥ | oṃ lokāpavādāsahyatvabodhibhaṭṭānusārakṛte namaḥ | oṃ āgamoktavrataikāntaniṣṭhabhaṭṭānumodakāya namaḥ | oṃ āgamoktyatilaṅghitvaduṣkīrtiparihārakṛte namaḥ | oṃ svakīyakṛtakṛtyatvākāñkṣibhaṭṭānusevikāya namaḥ ||460|| oṃ tārakākhyabrahmavidyāpekṣibhaṭṭābhilāṣakṛte namaḥ |
analyzed: om karaka ambu kaṇā seka jīvana utsuka mānasāya namaḥ om loka apavāda asahya tva bodhi bhaṭṭa anusāra kṛte namaḥ om āgama ukta vrata ekānta niṣṭha bhaṭṭa anumodakāya namaḥ om āgama ukti atilaṅghi tva duṣkīrti parihāra kṛte namaḥ om svakīya kṛtakṛtya tva ākāñkṣi bhaṭṭa anusevikāya namaḥ om tāraka ākhya brahma vidyā apekṣi bhaṭṭa abhilāṣa kṛte namaḥ

original: oṃ maṇḍanākhyamahāsūrivijayapreritāya namaḥ | oṃ suhṛde namaḥ | oṃ tatpāṇḍityaguṇaślāghibhaṭṭapādapraṇoditāya namaḥ | oṃ pravṛttimārganiratatadvṛttāntaniśāmakāya namaḥ | oṃ maṇḍanāryajayodyogakartavyoktisusūcakāya namaḥ | oṃ durvāsaḥśāpasaṃjātavāṇīsthitiniśāmakāya namaḥ | oṃ bhaṭṭāntevāsimukhyatvābhijñāya namaḥ | oṃ vijñānasāgarāya namaḥ |
analyzed: om maṇḍana ākhya mahā sūri vijaya preritāya namaḥ om suhṛde namaḥ om tad pāṇḍitya guṇa ślāghi bhaṭṭa pāda praṇoditāya namaḥ om pravṛtti mārga nirata tad vṛttānta niśāmakāya namaḥ om maṇḍana ārya jaya udyoga kartavya ukti su sūcakāya namaḥ om durvāsas śāpa saṃjāta vāṇī sthiti niśāmakāya namaḥ om bhaṭṭa antevāsi mukhya tva abhijñāya namaḥ om vijñānasāgarāya namaḥ

original: oṃ bhāratīsākṣikānekavivādakaraṇeritāya namaḥ ||470|| oṃ tadīyajayamātrānyajayaprāptiniśāmakāya namaḥ | oṃ vārtikagranthakaraṇayogyatāśravaṇādṛtāya namaḥ | oṃ muhūrtamātrasānidhyaprārthibhaṭṭānumodakāya namaḥ | oṃ tārakabrahmakathanakṛtārthitakumārilāya namaḥ | oṃ paramādvaitatatvajñabhaṭṭapādānucintitāya namaḥ | oṃ bhaṭṭānugrahaṇodyuktāya namaḥ |
analyzed: om bhāratī sākṣika aneka vivāda karaṇa īritāya namaḥ om tadīya jaya mātra anya jaya prāpti niśāmakāya namaḥ om vārttika grantha karaṇa yogya tā śravaṇa ādṛtāya namaḥ om muhūrta mātra sānidhya prārthi bhaṭṭa anumodakāya namaḥ om tāraka brahma kathana kṛta arthita kumārilāya namaḥ om parama advaita tatva jña bhaṭṭa pāda anucintitāya namaḥ om bhaṭṭa anugrahaṇa udyuktāya namaḥ

original: oṃ viṣṇudhāmapraveśakāya namaḥ | oṃ ākāśamārgasamprāptamaṇḍanīyaniveśanāya namaḥ | oṃ māhiṣmatyākhyanagarīrāmaṇīyakadarśanāya namaḥ | oṃ revāvārikaṇonmiśravātadhūtākhilāśramāya namaḥ ||480|| oṃ revānadīkṛtasnānāya namaḥ | oṃ nityāhnīkaparāyaṇāya namaḥ | oṃ dṛgadhvanīnataddāsīdarśanāya namaḥ | oṃ mahimānvitāya namaḥ |
analyzed: om viṣṇu dhāma praveśakāya namaḥ om ākāśa mārga samprāpta maṇḍanīya niveśanāya namaḥ om māhiṣmatī ākhya nagarī rāmaṇīyaka darśanāya namaḥ om revā vāri kaṇā unmiśra vāta dhūta akhila āśramāya namaḥ om revā nadī kṛta snānāya namaḥ om nitya ahnīka parāyaṇāya namaḥ om dṛś adhvanī nata dāsī darśanāya namaḥ om mahima anvitāya namaḥ

original: oṃ maṇḍanīyamahāsadmamārgapraṣṭre namaḥ | oṃ mahāyaśase namaḥ | oṃ vismayākulataddāsīdattottarāya namaḥ | oṃ udāravāce namaḥ | oṃ svataḥprāmāṇyādivādiśukasūcitatadgṛhāya namaḥ | oṃ karmeśvarādisamvādiśukasūcitatadgṛhāya namaḥ ||490|| oṃ jagaddhṛvatvādivādiśukasūcitasadmakāya namaḥ | oṃ dvārasthanīḍasaṃruddhaśukoktiślāghanāparāya namaḥ |
analyzed: om maṇḍanīya mahā sadma mārga praṣṭre namaḥ om mahā yaśase namaḥ vismaya ākula tad dāsī datta uttarāya namaḥ om udāra vāce namaḥ om svatas prāmāṇya ādi vādi śuka sūcita tad gṛhāya namaḥ om karmeśvara ādi samvādi śuka sūcita tad gṛhāya namaḥ om namaḥ jagat hṛva tva ādi vādi śuka sūcita sadmakāya namaḥ om dvāra stha nīḍa saṃruddha śuka ukti ślāghanā parasmai namaḥ

original: oṃ yathoktacihnavijñātamaṇḍanīyaniveśanāya namaḥ | oṃ kavāṭaguptidurveśagṛhāntargaticintakāya namaḥ | oṃ yogamāhātmyaracitavyomamārgātilaṃghanāya namaḥ | oṃ aṅgaṇāntaḥsamutpātine namaḥ | oṃ parito dṛṣṭasadmakāya namaḥ | oṃ abhraṃlihamahāsadmarāmaṇīyakadarśanāya namaḥ | oṃ padmajanmāmśasambhūtamaṇḍanāryāvalokanāya namaḥ |
analyzed: om yathā ukta cihna vijñāta maṇḍanīya niveśanāya namaḥ om kavāṭa gupti durveśa gṛha antargati cintakāya namaḥ om yoga māhātmya racita vyoma mārga atilaṃghanāya namaḥ om aṅgaṇa antar samutpātine namaḥ om paritas dṛṣṭa sadmakāya namaḥ om abhraṃliha mahā sadma rāmaṇīyaka darśanāya namaḥ om padmajanma amśa sambhūta maṇḍana ārya avalokanāya namaḥ

original: oṃ nimantritavyāsajaiminyañghrikṣālanadarśakāya namaḥ ||500|| oṃ vyāsajaiminisāṅgatyadarśanātyantavismitāya namaḥ | oṃ tatkālakṛtasānnidhyavyāsajaiminimānitāya namaḥ | oṃ akasmādyatisamprāptikṛddhamaṇḍanavīkṣitāya namaḥ | oṃ pravṛttimārganiratamaṇḍanāryavimānitāya namaḥ | oṃ sopālambhatadīyoktisamādhānavicakṣaṇāya namaḥ |
analyzed: om nimantrita vyāsa jaimini añghri kṣālana darśakāya namaḥ om vyāsa jaimini sāṅgatya darśana atyanta vismitāya namaḥ om tad kāla kṛta sānnidhya vyāsa jaimini mānitāya namaḥ om akasmāt yati samprāpti kṛddha maṇḍana vīkṣitāya namaḥ om pravṛtti mārga nirata maṇḍana ārya vimānitāya namaḥ om sa upālambha tadīya ukti samādhāna vicakṣaṇāya namaḥ

original: oṃ maṇḍanīyākhilapraśnottaradānavidagdhadhiye namaḥ | oṃ vakroktijālacāturyaniruttaritamaṇḍanāya namaḥ | oṃ yatinindādoṣabodhivyāsavākyaniśāmakāya namaḥ | oṃ sākṣādviṣṇusvarūpatvabodhakavyāsadarśakāya namaḥ | oṃ vyāsājñāvākyavaśagamaṇḍanāryanimantritāya namaḥ ||510|| oṃ maṇḍanāryakṛtānekasaparyāvidhibhājanāya namaḥ |
analyzed: om maṇḍanīya akhila praśna uttara dāna vidagdha dhiye namaḥ om vakrokti jāla cāturya niruttarita maṇḍanāya namaḥ om yati nindā doṣa bodhi vyāsa vākya niśāmakāya namaḥ om sākṣāt viṣṇu sva rūpa tva bodhaka vyāsa darśakāya namaḥ om vyāsa ājñā vākya vaśaga maṇḍana ārya nimantritāya namaḥ om maṇḍana ārya kṛta aneka saparyā vidhi bhājanāya namaḥ

original: oṃ bhaikṣārtharacitāhvānāya namaḥ | oṃ vādabhikṣaikayācakāya namaḥ | oṃ vivādabhikṣāmātrārthisvāgamapratibodhakāya namaḥ | oṃ anyonyaśiṣyatāprāptipaṇabandhapradarśakāya namaḥ | oṃ anādṛtāhārabhikṣāya namaḥ | oṃ vādabhikṣāparāyaṇāya namaḥ | oṃ śrutyantamārgavistāramātrākaṅkṣitvabodhakāya namaḥ | oṃ vismayānandabharitamaṇḍanāryapraśamsitāya namaḥ |
analyzed: om bhaikṣa artha racita āhvānāya namaḥ om vāda bhikṣā eka yācakāya namaḥ om vivāda bhikṣā mātra arthi sva āgama pratibodhakāya namaḥ om anyonya śiṣya tā prāpti paṇa bandha pradarśakāya namaḥ om an ādṛta āhāra bhikṣāya namaḥ om vāda bhikṣā parāyaṇāya namaḥ om śruti anta mārga vistāra mātra ākaṅkṣi tva bodhakāya namaḥ om vismaya ānanda bharita maṇḍana ārya praśamsitāya namaḥ

original: oṃ cirākāṅkṣitasadvādakathātoṣitamaṇḍanāya namaḥ ||520|| oṃ vādabhikṣākṛtodyogamaṇḍanāryapraśamsakāya namaḥ | oṃ vivādasākṣiśūnyatvabodhimaṇḍanacoditāya namaḥ | oṃ munidvayīsākṣitārthimaṇḍanāryapraśamsakāya namaḥ | oṃ bhāratīkṛtamādhyasthyavādalolupamānasāya namaḥ | oṃ pratijñāpaṇabandhādijijñāsutvapradarśakāya namaḥ |
analyzed: om cira ākāṅkṣita sadvāda kathā toṣita maṇḍanāya namaḥ om vāda bhikṣā kṛta udyoga maṇḍana ārya praśamsakāya namaḥ om vivāda sākṣi śūnyatva bodhi maṇḍana coditāya namaḥ om muni dvayī sākṣitā arthi maṇḍana ārya praśamsakāya namaḥ om bhāratī kṛta mādhyasthya vāda lolupa mānasāya namaḥ om pratijñāpaṇa bandha ādi jijñāsu tva pradarśakāya namaḥ

original: oṃ maṇḍanāryakṛtāsaṃkhyavījanādyupacārakāya namaḥ | oṃ vyāsajaiminisānnidhyasambhāṣaṇaparāyaṇāya namaḥ | oṃ munidvayāntardhidarśine namaḥ | oṃ dvijendrālayanirgatāya namaḥ ||530|| oṃ revānadīsamīpasthadevālayanivāsakṛte namaḥ | oṃ nijaśiṣyajanaikāntasambhāṣaṇaparāyaṇāya namaḥ | oṃ śrāvitāśeṣaviṣayaśiṣyāvalisamāśritāya namaḥ |
analyzed: om maṇḍana ārya kṛta asaṃkhya vījana ādi upacārakāya namaḥ om vyāsa jaimini sānnidhya sambhāṣaṇa parāyaṇāya namaḥ om muni dvaya antardhi darśiṇe namaḥ om dvijendra ālaya nirgatāya namaḥ om revā nadī samīpa stha devālaya nivāsa kṛte namaḥ om nija śiṣya jana ekānta sambhāṣaṇa parāyaṇāya namaḥ om śrāvita aśeṣa viṣaya śiṣya āvali samāśritāya namaḥ

original: oṃ vyāsajaiminisānnidhyadurāpatvānucintakāya namaḥ | oṃ triyāmānirgamākāṅkṣiṇe namaḥ | oṃ prātaḥsnānaparāyaṇāya namaḥ | oṃ kṛtāhnikakriyāya namaḥ | oṃ śiṣyamaṇḍalīparimaṇḍitāya namaḥ | oṃ maṇḍanāryamahāsadmamaṇḍanāyitamūrtikāya namaḥ | oṃ vivādārthakṛtaikāntaniścayāya namaḥ ||540|| oṃ maṇḍanādṛtāya namaḥ |
analyzed: om vyāsa jaimini sānnidhya durāpa tva anucintakāya namaḥ om triyāmā nirgama ākāṅkṣiṇe namaḥ om prātaḥsnāna parāyaṇāya namaḥ om kṛta āhnika kriyāya namaḥ om śiṣya maṇḍalī parimaṇḍitāya namaḥ om maṇḍana ārya mahā sadma maṇḍanāyita mūrtikāya namaḥ om vivāda artha kṛta ekānta niścayāya namaḥ om maṇḍana ādṛtāya namaḥ

original: oṃ sadasyabhāvavilasadvāṇīsānnidhyadarśakāya namaḥ | oṃ vivādakṛtisannaddhamaṇḍanāryapraśamsakāya namaḥ | oṃ sadasyavādisamyogasamāhlāditamānasāya namaḥ | oṃ pratijñākaraṇotsāhine namaḥ | oṃ vedāntāśayasūcakāya namaḥ | oṃ viśvākārasamābhātabrahmyaikatvapradarśakāya namaḥ | oṃ śuktirūpyādidṛṣṭāntapratyāyitamṛṣātmakāya namaḥ |
analyzed: om sadasya bhāva vilasat vāṇī sānnidhya darśakāya namaḥ om vivāda kṛti sannaddha maṇḍana ārya praśamsakāya namaḥ om sadasya vādi samyoga samāhlādita mānasāya namaḥ om pratijñā karaṇa utsāhine namaḥ om vedānta āśaya sūcakāya namaḥ om viśva ākāra sama ābhāta brahmya ekatva pradarśakāya namaḥ om śukti rūpya ādi dṛṣṭānta pratyāyita mṛṣā ātmakāya namaḥ

original: oṃ brahmajñānaikasamprāpyasvātmasaṃsthitibodhakāya namaḥ ||550|| oṃ punarjanmāparāmṛṣṭakaivalyapratipādakāya namaḥ | oṃ trayīmastakasandohaprāmāṇyodghāṭanāparāya namaḥ | oṃ parājitasvasaṃprāpyaśuklavastratvabodhakāya namaḥ | oṃ jayāpajayapakṣīyavāṇīsākṣitvabodhakāya namaḥ | oṃ viśvarūpīyasakalapratijñāśravaṇotsukāya namaḥ |
analyzed: om brahma jñāna eka samprāpya sva ātma saṃsthiti bodhakāya namaḥ om punarjanma aparāmṛṣṭa kaivalya pratipādakāya namaḥ om trayī mastaka sandoha prāmāṇya udghāṭana aparāya namaḥ om parājita sva saṃprāpya śukla vastra tva bodhakāya namaḥ om jaya apajaya pakṣīya vāṇī sākṣi tva bodhakāya namaḥ om viśvarūpīya sakala pratijñā śravaṇa utsukāya namaḥ

original: oṃ vedāntāmānatābodhitadvākyaśravaṇāturāya namaḥ | oṃ karmakāṇḍīyavacanaprāmāṇyākarṇanākulāya namaḥ | oṃ kriyāyogivacomātraprāmāṇyākarṇanakṣamāya namaḥ | oṃ karmasaṃprāpyakaivalyabodhimaṇḍanadarśakāya namaḥ ||560|| oṃ yāvadāyuḥkarmajālakartavyatvoktisaṃśraviṇe namaḥ | oṃ parājitasvakāṣāyagrahavākyānumodakāya namaḥ |
analyzed: om namaḥ om karmakāṇḍīya vacana prāmāṇya ākarṇana ākulāya namaḥ om kriyāyogi vacaḥ mātra prāmāṇya ākarṇana kṣamāya namaḥ om karma saṃprāpya kaivalya bodhi maṇḍana darśakāya namaḥ om yāvat āyus karma jāla kartavya tva ukti saṃśraviṇe namaḥ om parājita sva kāṣāya graha vākya anumodakāya namaḥ

original: oṃ bhāratīsākṣikāsaṃkhyavādodyuktāya namaḥ | oṃ yatīśvarāya namaḥ | oṃ dainandināhnikopāntasamārabdhavivādakāya namaḥ | oṃ bhāratīnihitasvīyagalālambisumālikāya namaḥ | oṃ maṇḍanīyagalālambimālālālityadarśakāya namaḥ | oṃ mālāmālinyanirṇeyaparājayaniśāmakāya namaḥ | oṃ gṛhakarmasamāsaktavāṇīdattasubhaikṣyakāya namaḥ |
analyzed: om bhāratī sākṣika asaṃkhya vāda udyuktāya namaḥ om yati īśvarāya namaḥ om namaḥ om bhāratī nihita svīya gala ālambi sumālikāya namaḥ om maṇḍanīya gala ālambi mālā lālitya darśakāya namaḥ om mālā mālinya nirṇeya parājaya niśāmakāya namaḥ om gṛha karma samāsakta vāṇī datta su bhaikṣyakāya namaḥ

original: oṃ bhikṣottarakṣaṇārabdhavivādāparikhinnadhiye namaḥ ||570|| oṃ ūrdhvopaviṣṭabrahmādipītasvīyavaco'mṛtāya namaḥ | oṃ krodhavākphalajātyādidoṣaśūnyamahāvacase namaḥ | oṃ advaitakhaṇḍanodyuktamaṇḍanīyoktikhaṇḍanāya namaḥ | oṃ jīveśvarajagadbhedavādabhedanalālasāya namaḥ | oṃ uddhālakaśvetaketusamvādādinidarśakāya namaḥ |
analyzed: om bhikṣā uttara kṣaṇa ārabdha vivāda a parikhinna dhiye namaḥ om ūrdhva upaviṣṭa brahma ādi pīta svīya vacas mṛtāya namaḥ om krodha vāc phala jāti ādi doṣa śūnya mahā vacase namaḥ om advaita khaṇḍana udyukta maṇḍanīya ukti khaṇḍanāya namaḥ om jīva īśvara jagat bheda vāda bhedana lālasāya namaḥ om uddhālaka śvetaketu samvāda ādi nidarśakāya namaḥ

original: oṃ tattvamasyādivākyaughasvārasyapratipādakāya namaḥ | oṃ vidhiśeṣatvavacananirmūlatvapradarśakāya namaḥ | oṃ bhinnaprakaraṇopāttatattātparyapradarśakāya namaḥ | oṃ upāsanārthatāvādanirmūlanaparāyaṇāya namaḥ | oṃ kevalādvaitaviśrāntavākyatātparyadarśakāya namaḥ | oṃ saccidānandarūpātmapratipādanatatparāya namaḥ ||580||
analyzed: om tattvamasi ādi vākya ogha svārasya pratipādakāya namaḥ om vidhi śeṣa tva vacana nirmūla tva pradarśakāya namaḥ om bhinna prakaraṇa upātta tad tātparya pradarśakāya namaḥ om upāsana arthatā vāda nirmūlana parāyaṇāya namaḥ om kevala advaita viśrānta vākya tātparya darśakāya namaḥ om saccidānanda rūpa ātma pratipādana tatparāya namaḥ

original: oṃ japamātropayogitvaniryuktitvānudarśakāya namaḥ | oṃ abhedabodhivākyaughaprābalyaparidarśakāya namaḥ | oṃ bhedabuddhipramāṇatvasarvāṃśonmūlanakṣamāya namaḥ | oṃ bhedasaṃdarśivākyaughaprāmāṇyābhāvasādhakāya namaḥ | oṃ bhedapratyakṣyadaurbalyapratipādanatatparāya namaḥ | oṃ bhedanindāsahasroktitātparyapratipādakāya namaḥ |
analyzed: om japa mātra upayogi tva niryukti tva anudarśakāya namaḥ om abheda bodhi vākya ogha prābalya paridarśakāya namaḥ om bheda buddhi pramāṇa tva sarva aṃśa unmūlana kṣamāya namaḥ om bheda saṃdarśi vākya ogha prāmāṇya abhāva sādhakāya namaḥ om bheda pratyakṣya daurbalya pratipādana tatparāya namaḥ om bheda nindā sahasra ukti tātparya pratipādakāya namaḥ

original: oṃ lokaprasiddhabhedānuvādakatvapradarśakāya namaḥ | oṃ aprasiddhādvaitabodhivākyaprāmāṇyasādhakāya namaḥ | oṃ nānādṛṣṭāntasaṃdarśine namaḥ | oṃ śrutivākyanidarśakāya namaḥ ||590|| oṃ yuktisāhasraghaṭitasvānubhūtipradarśakāya namaḥ | oṃ śrutiyuktisusauhārdadarśakāya namaḥ | oṃ vītamatsarāya namaḥ |
analyzed: om loka prasiddha bheda anuvādaka tva pradarśakāya namaḥ om aprasiddha advaita bodhi vākya prāmāṇya sādhakāya namaḥ om nānā dṛṣṭānta saṃdarśiṇe namaḥ om śruti vākya nidarśakāya namaḥ om yukti sāhasra ghaṭita sva anubhūti pradarśakāya namaḥ om śruti yukti su sauhārda darśakāya namaḥ om vīta matsarāya namaḥ

original: oṃ hetudoṣāṃśasaṃdarśimaṇḍanākṣepakhaṇḍanāya namaḥ | oṃ bhedaupādhikatābodhine namaḥ | oṃ satyādvaitānudarśakāya namaḥ | oṃ asamsāriparabrahmasādhanaikāntamānasāya namaḥ | oṃ kṣetrajñaparamātmaikyavādigītādinidarśakāya namaḥ | oṃ adyāropāpavādāptaniṣprapañcatvadarśakāya namaḥ | oṃ yuktisāhasraracitadurvādimatakhaṇḍanāya namaḥ ||600||
analyzed: om hetu doṣa aṃśa saṃdarśi maṇḍana ākṣepa khaṇḍanāya namaḥ om bheda aupādhika tā bodhine namaḥ om satya advaita anudarśakāya namaḥ om asamsāri para brahma sādhana ekānta mānasāya namaḥ om kṣetrajña paramātma aikya vādi gīta ādi nidarśakāya namaḥ om adya āropa apavāda āpta niṣprapañca tva darśakāya namaḥ om yukti sāhasra racita durvādi mata khaṇḍanāya namaḥ om yukti sāhasra racita durvādi mata khaṇḍanāya namaḥ

original: oṃ maṇḍanīyagalālambimālāmālinyadarśakāya namaḥ | oṃ puṣpavṛṣṭisaṃchannāya namaḥ | oṃ bhāratīpratinanditāya namaḥ | oṃ bhikṣākālopasaṃprāptabhāratīparidarśakāya namaḥ | oṃ ubhayāhvānakṛdvāṇīvaidagdhyaślāghanāparāya namaḥ | oṃ bhāratībodhitasvīyadurvāsaḥśāpasaṃśraviṇe namaḥ | oṃ jayāvadhikatacchāpavṛttāntākarṇanāya namaḥ | oṃ vaśine namaḥ |
analyzed: om maṇḍanīya gala ālambi mālā mālinya darśakāya namaḥ om puṣpa vṛṣṭi saṃchannāya namaḥ om bhāratī pratinanditāya namaḥ om bhikṣā kāla upasaṃprāpta bhāratī paridarśakāya namaḥ om ubhaya āhvāna kṛt vāṇī vaidagdhya ślāghanā parasmai namaḥ om bhāratī bodhita svīya durvāsas śāpa saṃśraviṇe namaḥ om jaya avadhika tad śāpa vṛttānta ākarṇanāya namaḥ om vaśine namaḥ

original: oṃ svadhāmagamanodyuktabhāratīpratirodhakāya namaḥ | oṃ vanadurgāmahāmantrakṛtavāṇīsubādhanāya namaḥ ||610|| oṃ sarasvatyavatāratvabodhakāya namaḥ | oṃ vedavidvarāya namaḥ | oṃ bhaktimatparatantratvabodhakāya namaḥ | oṃ vinayojvalāya namaḥ | oṃ svānujñāvadhibhūlokanivāsaprārthanāparāya namaḥ | oṃ maṇḍanīyāśayajñānapravṛttāya namaḥ |
analyzed: om svadhāma gamana udyukta bhāratī pratirodhakāya namaḥ om vana durgā mahā mantra kṛta vāṇī su bādhanāya namaḥ om sarasvatī avatāra tva bodhakāya namaḥ om veda vid varāya namaḥ om bhaktimat paratantra tva bodhakāya namaḥ om vinaya ujvalāya namaḥ om sva anujñā avadhi bhū loka nivāsa prārthanā parasmai om maṇḍanīya āśaya jñāna pravṛttāya namaḥ

original: oṃ vigataspṛhāya namaḥ | oṃ karmajāḍyaparābhūtatatsandehāpanodakāya namaḥ | oṃ nijāpajayasaṃjātaduḥkhābhāvoktisaṃśraviṇe namaḥ | oṃ jaiminyuktinirāśānuśocanmaṇḍanabodhakāya namaḥ ||620|| oṃ kāmanāvadanugrāhijaiminyāśayabodhakāya namaḥ | oṃ karmapraṇāḍīmātratvabodhine namaḥ | oṃ jaiminisammatāya namaḥ | oṃ sākṣānmokṣaikaphalakajñānavācine namaḥ |
analyzed: om vigata spṛhāya namaḥ om karma jāḍya parābhūta tad sandeha apanodakāya namaḥ om nija apajaya saṃjāta duḥkha abhāva ukti saṃśraviṇe namaḥ om jaiminī ukti nirāśa anu śocat maṇḍana bodhakāya namaḥ om kāmanāvat anugrāhi jaiminī āśaya bodhakāya namaḥ om karma praṇāḍī mātra tva bodhine namaḥ om jaimini sammatāya namaḥ om sākṣāt mokṣa eka phalaka jñāna vācine namaḥ

original: oṃ mahāvacase namaḥ | oṃ karmaughaphaladātṛtvānupapattiprapañcakāya namaḥ | oṃ īśaikaphaladātṛtvasādhakāya namaḥ | oṃ yuktibodhakāya namaḥ | oṃ jaiminīyavacojālatātparyodghāṭanakṣamāya namaḥ | oṃ anumeyeśvarābhāvamātratātparyasūcakāya namaḥ | oṃ vedaikagamyeśavādijaiminyāśayasūcakāya namaḥ | oṃ ḍolāyamānahṛdayamaṇḍanāryāvalokanāya namaḥ |
analyzed: om mahāvacase namaḥ om karma ogha phala dātṛ tva anupapatti prapañcakāya namaḥ om īśa eka phala dātṛ tva sādhakāya namaḥ om yukti bodhakāya namaḥ om jaiminīya vacaḥ jāla tātparya udghāṭana kṣamāya namaḥ om anumeya īśvara abhāva mātra tātparya sūcakāya namaḥ om veda eka gamya īśa vādi jaiminī āśaya sūcakāya namaḥ om ḍolāyamāna hṛdaya maṇḍana ārya avalokanāya namaḥ

original: oṃ tatsandehāpanodārthāgatajaiminiśamsakāya namaḥ | oṃ svoktasarvāṃśasādhutvabodhijaiminiśamsakāya namaḥ | oṃ jaiminyuditasarvajñabhāvāya namaḥ | oṃ jaiminipūjitāya namaḥ | oṃ nijāvatārasaṃsūcijaiminipratinanditāya namaḥ | oṃ jaiminivyāsavacanatātparyāṃśapradarśakāya namaḥ | oṃ jaiminyantardhisaṃdarśine namaḥ |
analyzed: om tad sandeha apanoda artha āgata jaimini śamsakāya namaḥ om sva ukta sarva aṃśa sādhu tva bodhi jaimini śamsakāya namaḥ om jaiminī udita sarvajña bhāvāya namaḥ om jaimini pūjitāya namaḥ om nija avatāra saṃsūci jaimini pratinanditāya namaḥ om jaimini vyāsa vacana tātparya aṃśa pradarśakāya namaḥ om jaimini antardhi saṃdarśine namaḥ

original: oṃ sarvato jayabhājanāya namaḥ ||640|| oṃ sāṣṭāṅgapātapraṇatamaṇḍanāryaprasādakṛte namaḥ | oṃ svīyāvatāratābhijñamaṇḍanāryābhinanditāya namaḥ | oṃ svānabhijñatvānuśocimaṇḍanāryaprasaṃsakāya namaḥ | oṃ svakarmajāḍyānuśocanmaṇḍanoktyabhinandakāya namaḥ | oṃ samsāratāpasambodhimaṇḍanoktyabhinandakāya namaḥ |
analyzed: om sarvatas jaya bhājanāya namaḥ om sa aṣṭāṅga pāta praṇata maṇḍana ārya prasāda kṛte namaḥ om svīya avatāra tā abhijña maṇḍana ārya abhinanditāya namaḥ om sva anabhijña tva anuśoci maṇḍana ārya prasaṃsakāya namaḥ om sva karma jāḍya anuśocat maṇḍana ukti abhinandakāya namaḥ om samsāra tāpa sambodhi maṇḍana ukti abhinandakāya namaḥ

original: oṃ paramānandalaharīviharanmaṇḍanādṛtāya namaḥ | oṃ svājñānatimirāpāyabodhimaṇḍanaśamsakāya namaḥ | oṃ avidyārākṣasīgrastaparamātmoddhṛtikṣamāya namaḥ | oṃ svāparādhakṣamāpekṣimaṇḍanāryābhiyācitāya namaḥ | oṃ maṇḍanāryakṛtasvīyāvatāratvasamarthanāya namaḥ ||650|| oṃ pūrvārjitasvasukṛtaślāghimaṇḍanapūjitāya namaḥ |
analyzed: om parama ānanda laharī viharat maṇḍana ādṛtāya namaḥ om sva ajñāna timira apāya bodhi maṇḍana śamsakāya namaḥ om avidyā rākṣasī grasta paramātma uddhṛti kṣamāya namaḥ om sva aparādha kṣama apekṣi maṇḍana ārya abhiyācitāya namaḥ om maṇḍana ārya kṛta svīya avatāra tva samarthanāya namaḥ om pūrva arjita sva su kṛta ślāghi maṇḍana pūjitāya namaḥ

original: oṃ svasamvādātisantuṣṭamaṇḍanādhikananditāya namaḥ | oṃ svasamvādātidaurlabhyabodhimaṇḍanaśamsakāya namaḥ | oṃ nānāstutivacoguṃphasantuṣṭasvāntasamyutāya namaḥ | oṃ maṇḍanāryakṛtāsaṃkhyanamovākapraśaṃsanāya namaḥ | oṃ maṇḍanāracitastokastutisāhasrabhājanāya namaḥ | oṃ svapādaśaraṇāpannamaṇḍanānugrahotsukāya namaḥ |
analyzed: om sva samvāda ati santuṣṭa maṇḍana adhika nanditāya namaḥ om sva samvāda ati daurlabhya bodhi maṇḍana śamsakāya namaḥ om nānā stuti vacaḥ guṃpha santuṣṭa svānta samyutāya namaḥ om maṇḍana ārya kṛta asaṃkhya namovāka praśaṃsanāya namaḥ om maṇḍana āracita stoka stuti sāhasra bhājanāya namaḥ om sva pāda śaraṇa āpanna maṇḍana anugraha utsukāya namaḥ

original: oṃ nijakiṅkaratābodhimaṇḍanoktipraśamsakāya namaḥ | oṃ maṇḍanīyamahābhaktitaralīkṛtamānasāya namaḥ | oṃ tadīyajanmasāphalyāpādanodyatamānasāya namaḥ ||660|| oṃ sutadāragṛhatyāgāsaktamaṇḍanaśamsakāya namaḥ | oṃ maṇḍanīyakalatrānumatisampādanotsukāya namaḥ | oṃ munyuktasarvavṛttajñavāṇīsamanumoditāya namaḥ |
analyzed: om nija kiṅkara tā bodhi maṇḍana ukti praśamsakāya namaḥ om maṇḍanīya mahā bhakti taralīkṛta mānasāya namaḥ om tadīya janma sāphalya āpādana udyata mānasāya namaḥ om suta dāra gṛha tyāga āsakta maṇḍana śamsakāya namaḥ om maṇḍanīya kalatra anumati sampādana utsukāya namaḥ om muni ukta sarva vṛtta jña vāṇī samanumoditāya namaḥ

original: oṃ maṇḍanaprāptaśiṣyatvābodhivāṇīpraśamsakāya namaḥ | oṃ munyuktasarvavṛttāntayāthārthyaparicintakāya namaḥ | oṃ samagravijayābhāvabodhivāṇyukticintakāya namaḥ | oṃ nijārdhabhāgatāvācivāṇiprāgalbhyacintakāya namaḥ | oṃ mahilājanasamvādadoṣodghāṭanatatparāya namaḥ | oṃ yājñavalkyastrīvivādadarśivāṇyuktipūjakāya namaḥ |
analyzed: om maṇḍana prāpta śiṣya tva abodhi vāṇī praśamsakāya namaḥ om muni ukta sarva vṛttānta yāthārthya paricintakāya namaḥ om samagra vijaya abhāva bodhi vāṇī ukti cintakāya namaḥ om nija ardha bhāga tā vāci vāṇi prāgalbhya cintakāya namaḥ om mahilā jana samvāda doṣa udghāṭana tatparāya namaḥ om yājñavalkya strī vivāda darśi vāṇī ukti pūjakāya namaḥ

original: oṃ sulabhājanakādyuktipratyuktiparicintakāya namaḥ ||670|| oṃ vidvatsabhāmadhyavartine namaḥ | oṃ vāṇīsamvādakāya namaḥ | oṃ vāgjharīmādhurīyogadūrīkṛtasudhārasāya namaḥ | oṃ bhāratīcintitāśeṣaśāstrājayyatvavaibhavāya namaḥ | oṃ atibālyakṛtasanyāsāya namaḥ | oṃ viṣayaughaparāṅgmukhāya namaḥ | oṃ kāmaśāstrakṛtapraśnāya namaḥ |
analyzed: om sulabhā janaka ādi ukti pratyukti paricintakāya namaḥ om vidvas sabhā madhya vartine namaḥ om vāṇī samvādakāya namaḥ om vāc jharī mādhurī yoga dūrīkṛta sudhā rasāya namaḥ om bhāratī cintita aśeṣa śāstra ajayya tva vaibhavāya namaḥ om ati bālya kṛta sanyāsāya namaḥ om viṣaya ogha para aṅgmukhāya namaḥ om kāmaśāstra kṛta praśnāya namaḥ

original: oṃ cintanāparamānasāya namaḥ | oṃ janāpavādacakitāya namaḥ | oṃ yatidharmapravartakāya namaḥ ||680|| oṃ kāmaśāstrānabhijñatvabahiḥprakaṭanodyatāya namaḥ | oṃ māsamātrāvadhiprārthine namaḥ | oṃ vāṇyanujñātāya namaḥ | oṃ ātmavate namaḥ | oṃ gamanārthakṛtodyogāya namaḥ | oṃ śiṣyāvalipariṣkṛtāya namaḥ | oṃ yogaśaktikṛtākāśasañcārāya namaḥ |
analyzed: om cintana apara mānasāya namaḥ om jana apavāda cakitāya namaḥ om yati dharma pravartakāya namaḥ om kāmaśāstra anabhijña tva bahis prakaṭana udyatāya namaḥ om māsa mātra avadhi prārthine namaḥ om vāṇī anujñātāya namaḥ om ātmavate namaḥ om gamana artha kṛta udyogāya namaḥ om śiṣya āvali pariṣkṛtāya namaḥ om yoga śakti kṛta ākāśa sañcārāya namaḥ

original: oṃ yogatatvavide namaḥ | oṃ gatacetanabhūpālagātradarśine namaḥ | oṃ prahṛṣṭadhiye namaḥ | oṃ pramadājanasamvītarājakāyapradarśakāya namaḥ | oṃ taccharīranupraveśasamutsukitamānasāya namaḥ | oṃ sanandanādisacchiṣyasamāpṛcchāparāyaṇāya namaḥ | oṃ bhaktimattarapadmāṅghriniṣiddhagamanāya namaḥ | oṃ vratine namaḥ |
analyzed: om yoga tatva vide namaḥ om gata cetana bhūpāla gātra darśiṇe namaḥ om prahṛṣṭa dhiye namaḥ om pramadā jana samvīta rāja kāya pradarśakāya namaḥ om tad śarīḥ anupraveśa samutsukita mānasāya namaḥ om sanandana ādi sat śiṣya samāpṛcchā parāyaṇāya namaḥ om bhaktimattara padma aṅghri niṣiddha gamanāya namaḥ om vratine namaḥ

original: oṃ sanandanoktaviṣayākarṣakatvasvabhāvakāya namaḥ | oṃ ūrdhvaretovratāpohaśaṅkipadmāṅghribodhakāya namaḥ | oṃ sanyāsadharmaśaithilyāśaṅkipadmāṅghrivāritāya namaḥ | oṃ dehābhimānavanmātrapāpasambhavabodhakāya namaḥ | oṃ nirahaṅkārakarmaughalepābhāvāvabodhakāya namaḥ ||700|| oṃ guhāhitātmīyadeharakṣaṇīyatvabodhakāya namaḥ |
analyzed: om sanandana ukta viṣaya ākarṣaka tva svabhāvakāya namaḥ om ūrdhvaretas vrata apoha śaṅki padmāṅghri bodhakāya namaḥ om sanyāsa dharma śaithilya āśaṅki padmāṅghri vāritāya namaḥ om deha abhimānavat mātra pāpa sambhava bodhakāya namaḥ om nirahaṅkāra karma ogha lepa abhāva avabodhakāya namaḥ om guhā hita ātmīya deha rakṣaṇīya tva bodhakāya namaḥ

original: oṃ samprāptāmarakābhikhyarājadehāya namaḥ | oṃ viśeṣavide namaḥ | oṃ nijapraveśacalitarājakīyaśarīrabhṛte namaḥ | oṃ akasmājjīvasamprāptivismāpitatadaṅganāya namaḥ | oṃ prabhūtaharṣavanitāvyūhasandarśanotsukāya namaḥ | oṃ vismayānandabharitamantrimukhyābhinanditāya namaḥ | oṃ śaṅkhadundubhinirghoṣasamākarṇanatatparāya namaḥ ||710||
analyzed: om samprāpta amaraka abhikhya rāja dehāya namaḥ om viśeṣa vide namaḥ om nija praveśa calita rājakīya śarīra bhṛte namaḥ om akasmāt jīva samprāpti vismāpita tad aṅganāya namaḥ om prabhūta harṣa vanitā vyūha sandarśana utsukāya namaḥ om vismaya ānanda bharita mantri mukhya abhinanditāya namaḥ om śaṅkha dundubhi nirghoṣa samākarṇana tatparāya namaḥ

original: oṃ samastajanatānandajanakāya namaḥ | oṃ maṅgalapradāya namaḥ | oṃ purohitakṛtasvīyaśāntikarmaṇe namaḥ | oṃ śamāvanaye namaḥ | oṃ kṛtamāṅgalikāya namaḥ | oṃ bhadragajārūḍhāya namaḥ | oṃ nirīhitāya namaḥ | oṃ sacivādikṛtasvīyasatkārāya namaḥ | oṃ sādhusammatāya namaḥ | oṃ pṛthivīpālanodyuktāya namaḥ | oṃ dharmādharmaviśeṣavide namaḥ ||720||
analyzed: om samasta janatā ānanda janakāya namaḥ om maṅgala pradāya namaḥ om purohita kṛta svīya śānti karmaṇe namaḥ om śamāvanaye namaḥ om kṛta māṅgalikāya namaḥ om bhadragaja ārūḍhāya namaḥ om nirīhitāya namaḥ om saciva ādi kṛta svīya satkārāya namaḥ om sādhu sammatāya namaḥ om pṛthivī pālana udyuktāya namaḥ om dharma adharma viśeṣa vide namaḥ

original: oṃ nītimārgasuniṣṇātre namaḥ | oṃ rājakāryānupālakāya namaḥ | oṃ nijaudāryādijanitamantrisamśayabhājanāya namaḥ | oṃ svakīyaguṇasandohasamāhlāditasajjanāya namaḥ | oṃ parakāyapraveṣṭyatvajñātṛmantriprapūjitāya namaḥ | oṃ mantrivinyastanikhilarājyabhārāya namaḥ | oṃ dharādhipāya namaḥ | oṃ antaḥpurakṛtāvāsāya namaḥ | oṃ lalanājanasevitāya namaḥ |
analyzed: om nīti mārga su niṣṇātre namaḥ om rāja kārya anupālakāya namaḥ om nija audārya ādi janita mantri samśaya bhājanāya namaḥ om svakīya guṇa sandoha samāhlādita sat janāya namaḥ om parakāya praveṣṭya tva jñātṛ mantri prapūjitāya namaḥ om mantri vinyasta nikhila rājya bhārāya namaḥ om dharādhipāya namaḥ om antaḥpura kṛta āvāsāya namaḥ om lalanā jana sevitāya namaḥ

original: oṃ bhūpāladehasamprāptanānākrīḍāamahotsavāya namaḥ | oṃ viṣayānandavimukhāya namaḥ | oṃ viṣayaughavinindakāya namaḥ | oṃ viṣayārātiśamanāya namaḥ | oṃ viṣayātividūradhiye namaḥ | oṃ viṣayākhyamahāraṇyanikṛntanakuṭhārakāya namaḥ | oṃ viṣayākhyaviṣajvālāsamsparśarahitāya namaḥ | oṃ yamine namaḥ | oṃ viṣayāmbudhisamśoṣabaḍabāgniśikhāyitāya namaḥ |
analyzed: om bhūpāla deha samprāpta nānā krīḍā amahā utsavāya namaḥ om viṣaya ānanda vimukhāya namaḥ om viṣaya ogha vinindakāya namaḥ om viṣaya arāti śamanāya namaḥ om viṣaya ati vidūra dhiye namaḥ om viṣaya ākhya mahā araṇya nikṛntana kuṭhārakāya namaḥ om viṣaya ākhya viṣa jvālā samsparśa rahitāya namaḥ om yamine namaḥ om viṣaya ambudhi samśoṣa baḍabāgni śikhāyitāya namaḥ

original: oṃ kāmakrodhādiṣaḍvairidūrībhūtāntaraṅgakāya namaḥ | oṃ viṣayāsāratādarśine namaḥ ||740|| oṃ viṣayānākulāṃtarāya namaḥ | oṃ viṣayākhyagajavrātadamanodyuktakesariṇe namaḥ | oṃ viṣayavyāghradarpaghnāya namaḥ | oṃ viṣayavyālavaidyakāya namaḥ | oṃ viṣayaughadurantatvacintakāya namaḥ | oṃ vītacāpalāya namaḥ |
analyzed: om kāma krodha ādi ṣaṣ vairi dūrībhūta antaraṅgakāya namaḥ om viṣaya asāra tā darśiṇe namaḥ om viṣaya an ākula antarāya namaḥ om viṣaya ākhya gaja vrāta damana udyukta kesariṇe namaḥ om viṣaya vyāghra darpa ghnāya namaḥ om viṣaya vyāla vaidyakāya namaḥ om viṣaya ogha duranta tva cintakāya namaḥ om vīta cāpalāya namaḥ

original: oṃ vātsānayakalāsārasarvasvagrahaṇotsukāya namaḥ | oṃ bhūpadehakṛtāsaṃkhyabhogāya namaḥ | oṃ nṛpativeṣabhṛte namaḥ | oṃ samayātyayasambodhiśiṣyavargānucintitāya namaḥ ||750|| oṃ duḥkhārṇavanimagnasvaśiṣyavargānucintakāya namaḥ | oṃ itikartavyatāmūḍhaśiṣyavargagaveṣitāya namaḥ | oṃ mṛtotthiyanṛpaśrotṛśiṣyābhijṅātadhāmakāya namaḥ |
analyzed: om vātsa anaya kalā sāra sarva sva grahaṇa utsukāya namaḥ om bhūpa deha kṛta asaṃkhya bhogāya namaḥ om nṛpati veṣa bhṛte namaḥ om samaya atyaya sambodhi śiṣya varga anucintitāya namaḥ om duḥkha arṇava nimagna sva śiṣya varga anucintakāya namaḥ om itikartavya tā mūḍha śiṣya varga gaveṣitāya namaḥ om namaḥ

original: oṃ nānāruciraveṣāḍhyanijaśiṣyāvalokanāya namaḥ | oṃ gānavidyātinaipuṇyaśiṣyanāgāvakarṇanāya namaḥ | oṃ anyopadeśaracitahṛdyapadyasusamśraviṇe namaḥ | oṃ nānārthagarbhaśiṣyoktapayārthaparicintakāya namaḥ | oṃ vedāntārthapariprotavākyaśravaṇakautikine namaḥ | oṃ tatvamasyādiśiṣyoktavākyārthaparicintakāya namaḥ |
analyzed: om nānā rucira veṣa āḍhya nija śiṣya avalokanāya namaḥ om gāna vidyā ati naipuṇya śiṣya nāga avakarṇanāya namaḥ om anya upadeśa racita hṛdya padya su samśraviṇe namaḥ om nānā artha garbha śiṣya ukta payas artha paricintakāya namaḥ om vedānta artha pariprota vākya śravaṇa kautikine namaḥ om tatvam asi ādi śiṣya ukta vākya artha paricintakāya namaḥ

original: oṃ sarvavedāntasaṃgūḍhaparamātmānucintakāya namaḥ | oṃ nijaśiṣyāśayābhijṅāya namaḥ | oṃ nijakāyapraveśakṛte namaḥ | oṃ daṃdahyamānātmadehadarśine namaḥ | oṃ tvaritamānasāya namaḥ | oṃ tadānīntanasantāpaśamanopāyacintakāya namaḥ | oṃ lakṣmīnṛsimhastavananiścitātmane namaḥ | oṃ supadyakṛte namaḥ | oṃ nānāstutivacogumphaprīṇitaśrīnṛsimhakāya namaḥ |
analyzed: om sarva vedānta saṃgūḍha paramātma anucintakāya namaḥ om nija śiṣya āśaya abhijṅāya namaḥ om nija kāya praveśa kṛte namaḥ om daṃdahyamāna ātma deha darśine namaḥ om tvarita mānasāya namaḥ om tadānīntana santāpa śamana upāya cintakāya namaḥ om lakṣmī nṛsimha stavana niścita ātmane namaḥ om supadya kṛte namaḥ om nānā stuti vacaḥ gumpha prīṇita śrī nṛsimhakāya namaḥ

original: oṃ nṛsimhakaruṇāśāntasantāpavapurāśritāya namaḥ | oṃ sanandanādisacchiṣyasamvṛtobhayapārśvakāya namaḥ ||770|| oṃ nijavṛttāntakathanatatparāya namaḥ | oṃ śiṣyabhāvavide namaḥ | oṃ ākāśamārgagamanāya namaḥ | oṃ maṇḍanāryaniveśadṛśe namaḥ | oṃ viṣayāsvādavimukhamaṇḍanāryābhinandakāya namaḥ | oṃ maṇḍanāryakṛtāsaṃkhyapraṇāmāñjalidānakāya namaḥ |
analyzed: om nṛsimha karuṇā śānta santāpa vapuḥ āśritāya namaḥ om sanandana ādi sat śiṣya samvṛta ubhaya pārśvakāya namaḥ om nija vṛttānta kathana tatparāya namaḥ om śiṣya bhāva vide namaḥ om ākāśa mārga gamanāya namaḥ om maṇḍana ārya niveśa dṛśe namaḥ om viṣaya āsvāda vimukha maṇḍana ārya abhinandakāya namaḥ om maṇḍana ārya kṛta asaṃkhya praṇāma añjali dānakāya namaḥ

original: oṃ sannyāsaniścitasvāntamaṇḍanāryapraśaṃsakāya namaḥ | oṃ viṣṭarasthitiviśrāntāya namaḥ | oṃ śāradākṛtadarśanāya namaḥ | oṃ śāradāślāghitasvīyasārvajñyāya namaḥ ||780|| oṃ vādalolupāya namaḥ | oṃ nijadhāmagamodyuktavāṇyantardhānadarśakāya namaḥ | oṃ yogamāhātmyasaṃdṛṣṭavāṇībhāṣaṇatatparāya namaḥ | oṃ vidhipatnītvasaṃdarśine namaḥ |
analyzed: om sannyāsa niścita svānta maṇḍana ārya praśaṃsakāya namaḥ om viṣṭara sthiti viśrāntāya namaḥ om śāradā kṛta darśanāya namaḥ om śāradā ślāghita svīya sārvajñyāya namaḥ om vāda lolupāya namaḥ om nija dhāma gama udyukta vāṇi antardhāna darśakāya namaḥ om yoga māhātmya saṃdṛṣṭa vāṇī bhāṣaṇa tatparāya namaḥ om vidhi patnī tva saṃdarśiṇe namaḥ

original: oṃ tanmāhātmyānudarśakāya namaḥ | oṃ svakalpitarṣyaśṛṅgādikṣetravāsābhikāṅkṣakāya namaḥ | oṃ śṛṅgagiryādisukṣetrasānidhyaprārthanāparāya namaḥ | oṃ bhāratīsamanujñātakṣetrasānidhyatoṣitāya namaḥ | oṃ akasmātantardhidarśine namaḥ ||790|| oṃ vismayākulamānasāya namaḥ | oṃ vidhivaddattasarvasvamaṇḍanāryānumodakāya namaḥ |
analyzed: om tad māhātmya anudarśakāya namaḥ om sva kalpita ṛṣya śṛṅga ādi kṣetra vāsa abhikāṅkṣakāya namaḥ om śṛṅgagiri ādi su kṣetra sānidhya prārthanā parasmai namaḥ om bhāratī samanujñāta kṣetra sānidhya toṣitāya namaḥ om akasmāt antardhi darśiṇe namaḥ om vismaya ākula mānasāya namaḥ om vidhivat datta sarva sva maṇḍana ārya anumodakāya namaḥ

original: oṃ sannyāsagṛhyavidhyuktasarvakarmopadeśakāya namaḥ | oṃ śrīmanmaṇḍanakarṇoktamahāvākyacatuṣṭayāya namaḥ | oṃ mahāvākyagatāśeṣatatvārthaśrāvakāya namaḥ | oṃ gurave namaḥ | oṃ tatvam padagavācyārthalakṣyārthapratipādakāya namaḥ | oṃ lakṣobhayārthaikyabodhine namaḥ | oṃ nānādṛṣṭāntadarśakāya namaḥ | oṃ dehādyahamtāmamatāsamūlonmūlanakramāya namaḥ |
analyzed: om sannyāsa gṛhya vidhi ukta sarva karma upadeśakāya namaḥ om śrīmat maṇḍanakarṇa ukta mahāvākya catuṣṭayāya namaḥ om mahāvākya gata aśeṣa tatva artha śrāvakāya namaḥ om gurave namaḥ om tatvam pada ga vācya artha lakṣya artha pratipādakāya namaḥ om lakṣa ubhaya artha aikya bodhine namaḥ om nānā dṛṣṭānta darśakāya namaḥ om deha ādi aham tā mama tā sa mūla unmūlana kramāya namaḥ

original: oṃ bṛhadāraṇyakaproktamahāmatsyanidarśakāya namaḥ | oṃ jāgradādyātmasambandharāhityapratipādakāya namaḥ | oṃ vivartavādasiddhāntasamarthanaparāyaṇāya namaḥ | oṃ tātparyaliṅganirṇītaparamādvaitatatvakāya namaḥ | oṃ gurumāhātmyasaṃdarśine namaḥ | oṃ tatvavide namaḥ | oṃ tatvabodhakāya namaḥ | oṃ nijāṅghriyugmapatitasureśvarakaṭākṣakṛte namaḥ |
analyzed: om bṛhat āraṇyaka prokta mahā matsya nidarśakāya namaḥ om jāgrat ādi ātma sambandha rāhitya pratipādakāya namaḥ om vivarta vāda siddhānta samarthana parāyaṇāya namaḥ om tātparya liṅga nirṇīta parama advaita tatvakāya namaḥ om guru māhātmya saṃdarśine namaḥ om tatva vide namaḥ om tatva bodhakāya namaḥ om nija aṅghri yugma patita sureśvara kaṭākṣa kṛte namaḥ

original: oṃ karuṇāliṅgitāpāṅgakṣapitāntastamomalāya namaḥ | oṃ sureśvarākhyāsaṃdātre namaḥ ||810|| oṃ sureśvarasupūjitāya namaḥ | oṃ narmadātīrasaṃvāsine namaḥ | oṃ śrīśailagamanotsukāya namaḥ | oṃ mallikārjunasaṃdarśine namaḥ | oṃ bhramarāmbāpraṇāmakṛte namaḥ | oṃ māheśvarādivijayiśiṣyavargasamāśritāya namaḥ |
analyzed: om karuṇā āliṅgita apāṅga kṣapita antar tamas malāya namaḥ om sureśvara ākhyā saṃdātre namaḥ om sureśvara ākhyā saṃdātre namaḥ om sureśvara supūjitāya namaḥ om narmadā tīra saṃvāsine namaḥ om śrīśaila gamana utsukāya namaḥ om mallikārjuna saṃdarśine namaḥ om bhramara ambā praṇāma kṛte namaḥ om māheśvara ādi vijayi śiṣya varga samāśritāya namaḥ

original: oṃ aśeṣadikprasṛmarayaśojyotsnāniśākarāya namaḥ | oṃ nijamāhātmyasaṃśrotṛkāpālikakṛtānataye namaḥ | oṃ kāpālikakṛtānekastutijālāya namaḥ | oṃ nirādarāya namaḥ ||820|| oṃ kapāliprīṇanārthasvagamanoktisusaṃśraviṇe namaḥ | oṃ sarvajñamastakāpekṣitaduktiparicintakāya namaḥ | oṃ nijasarvajñatāvācikāpāloktivicintakāya namaḥ |
analyzed: om aśeṣa diś prasṛmara yaśas jyotsnā niśākarāya namaḥ om nija māhātmya saṃśrotṛ kāpālika kṛta ānataye namaḥ om kāpālika kṛta aneka stuti jālāya namaḥ om nirādarāya namaḥ om kapāli prīṇana artha sva gamana ukti su saṃśraviṇe namaḥ om sarvajña mastaka apekṣi tad ukti paricintakāya namaḥ om nija sarvajña tā vāci kāpāla ukti vicintakāya namaḥ

original: oṃ svaśiraḥprārthanodyuktakāpālikakṛtānataye namaḥ | oṃ bahvapāyasvīyakāyadoṣadarśanatatparāya namaḥ | oṃ paropakāranairatyavratapālanatatparāya namaḥ | oṃ nijakāyāpagamananirvyākulanijāntarāya namaḥ | oṃ samādhikālīnaśiraśchedānujñāpradāyakāya namaḥ | oṃ ekāntasaṃsthitāya namaḥ | oṃ yogine namaḥ ||830|| oṃ samādhyālīnamānasāya namaḥ |
analyzed: om sva śiras prārthanā udyukta kāpālika kṛta ānataye namaḥ om bahu a pāyasvīya kāya doṣa darśana tatparāya namaḥ om para upakāra nairatya vrata pālana tatparāya namaḥ om nija kāya apagamana nirvyākula nija antarāya namaḥ om samādhi kālīna śiraḥ cheda anujñā pradāyakāya namaḥ om ekānta saṃsthitāya namaḥ om yogine namaḥ om samādhi ālīna mānasāya namaḥ

original: oṃ paramātmānusandhānanirgatāśeṣacintanāya namaḥ | oṃ niṣkampadehāya namaḥ | oṃ nirmohāya namaḥ | oṃ nirantarasukhātmakāya namaḥ | oṃ svavadhodyuktakāpālikāgamanāvabodhakāya namaḥ | oṃ jatrupradeśanihitacibukāya namaḥ | oṃ dṛṣṭanāsikāya namaḥ | oṃ siddhāsanasamāsīnāya namaḥ | oṃ nirgatadvaitabhāvanāya namaḥ ||840||
analyzed: om paramātma anusandhāna nirgata aśeṣa cintanāya namaḥ om niṣkampa dehāya namaḥ om nirmohāya namaḥ om nirantara sukha ātmakāya namaḥ om sva vadha udyukta kāpālikā gamana avabodhakāya namaḥ om jatru pradeśa nihita cibukāya namaḥ om dṛṣṭa nāsikāya namaḥ om siddhāsana samāsīnāya namaḥ om nirgata dvaita bhāvanāya namaḥ

original: oṃ cinmātraparamānandalaharīmagnamānasāya namaḥ | oṃ kṛpāṇakarakāpālivadhodyogānavekṣakāya namaḥ | oṃ jñātavṛttāntapadmāṅghrimāritasvīyaśatrukāya namaḥ | oṃ nṛsimhaveṣapadmāṅghrikṛtārbhaṭavicālitāya namaḥ | oṃ samādhivyutthitamataye namaḥ | oṃ unmīlitavilocanāya namaḥ | oṃ tadaṭṭahāsanirghoṣabadhirībhūtakarṇakāya namaḥ |
analyzed: om cit mātra paramānanda laharī magna mānasāya namaḥ om kṛpāṇa kara kāpāli vadha udyoga anavekṣakāya namaḥ om jñāta vṛttānta padma aṅghri mārita svīya śatrukāya namaḥ om nṛsimha veṣa padma aṅghri kṛta arbhaṭa vicālitāya namaḥ om samādhi vyutthita mataye namaḥ om unmīlita vilocanāya namaḥ om tad aṭṭahāsa nirghoṣa badhirībhūta karṇakāya namaḥ

original: oṃ daṃṣṭrākarālavadanaśrīmannṛharidarśakāya namaḥ | oṃ āksmikanṛsimhāvalokanastimitāntarāya namaḥ | oṃ nirbhītāya namaḥ | oṃ galadānandabhāṣpāya namaḥ | oṃ stutiparāyaṇāya namaḥ | oṃ nṛsimhakrodhaśāntyarthaprārthanātatparāya namaḥ | oṃ yataye namaḥ | oṃ nṛsimhāveśasambhrāntapadmapādapradarśakāya namaḥ |
analyzed: om daṃṣṭra karāla vadana śrīmat nṛhari darśakāya namaḥ om āksmika nṛsimha avalokana stimita antarāya namaḥ om nirbhītāya namaḥ om galat ānanda bhāṣpāya namaḥ om stuti parāyaṇāya namaḥ om nṛsimha krodha śānti artha prārthanā tatparāya namaḥ om yataye namaḥ om nṛsimha āveśa sambhrānta padma pāda pradarśakāya namaḥ

original: oṃ svapnāyitasvavṛttāntajñātṛpadmāṅghripraṇatāya namaḥ | oṃ vismayākulāya namaḥ | oṃ gokarṇābhyarṇasañcāriṇe namaḥ | oṃ gokarṇeśvarapādābjapraṇantre namaḥ | oṃ prītamānasāya namaḥ | oṃ gokarṇanāthasamstotre namaḥ | oṃ trirātrasthititatparāya namaḥ | oṃ mūkāmbikāmahādevīsandarśanakṛtārthadhiye namaḥ | oṃ dvijadampatisandarśine namaḥ |
analyzed: om namaḥ om vismaya ākulāya namaḥ om gokarṇa abhyarṇa sañcāriṇe namaḥ om gokarṇa īśvara pāda abja praṇantre namaḥ om prīta mānasāya namaḥ om gokarṇa nātha samstotre namaḥ om tri rātra sthiti tatparāya namaḥ om mūka ambikā mahādevī sandarśana kṛtārtha dhiye namaḥ om dvija dampati sandarśine namaḥ

original: oṃ tadrodanavikhinnadhiye namaḥ | oṃ tadaṅkagāmimṛtakaśiśusandarśanāturāya namaḥ | oṃ anaṅgavāṇīsamśrotre namaḥ | oṃ putrojjīvanalālasāya namaḥ ||870|| oṃ dvijasamvarṇitasvīyamahimāya namaḥ | oṃ sarvapālakāya namaḥ | oṃ tatkālotthitatatputrajīvanaprītamānasāya namaḥ | oṃ nijamāhātmyasandraṣṭṛjanavismayakārakāya namaḥ |
analyzed: om tad rodana vikhinna dhiye namaḥ om tad aṅka gāmi mṛtaka śiśu sandarśana āturāya namaḥ om anaṅga vāṇī samśrotre namaḥ om putra ujjīvana lālasāya namaḥ om dvija samvarṇita svīya mahimāya namaḥ om sarva pālakāya namaḥ om tad kāla utthita tad putra jīvana prīta mānasāya namaḥ om nija māhātmya sandraṣṭṛ jana vismaya kārakāya namaḥ

original: oṃ mūkāmbādarśanākāṅkṣiṇe namaḥ | oṃ tatkṣetravāsatatparāya namaḥ | oṃ uccāvacagabhīrārthastotranirmāṇakautukine namaḥ | oṃ svakarmaniṣṭhaviprāḍhyaśrībaligrāmasevakāya namaḥ | oṃ prabhākarākhyasadviprabālamaugdhyāpanodakāya namaḥ | oṃ svapādaśaraṇāyātatadviprānugrahotsukāya namaḥ ||880|| oṃ praṇāmakartṛtatputrasamutthāpanatatparāya namaḥ |
analyzed: om mūka ambā darśana ākāṅkṣiṇe namaḥ om tad kṣetra vāsa tatparāya namaḥ om uccāvaca gabhīra artha stotra nirmāṇa kautukine namaḥ om sva karma niṣṭha vipra āḍhya śrī baligrāma sevakāya namaḥ om prabhākara ākhya sat vipra bāla maugdhya apanodakāya namaḥ om sva pāda śaraṇa āyāta tad vipra anugraha utsukāya namaḥ om praṇāma kartṛ tad putra samutthāpana tatparāya namaḥ

original: oṃ dvijavarṇitatatputramugdhaceṣṭāvacaḥśraviṇe namaḥ | oṃ antaḥpracchannavahnyābhadvijadārakadarśanāya namaḥ | oṃ tanmāhātmyaviśeṣajñāya namaḥ | oṃ maunamudrāvibhedakāya namaḥ | oṃ dvijadārakasaṃpraśnakaraṇodyatamānasāya namaḥ | oṃ tadīyajaḍatāhetupṛcchakāya namaḥ | oṃ karuṇākarāya namaḥ | oṃ bālaveṣapraticchannataduktiśravaṇotsukāya namaḥ |
analyzed: om dvija varṇita tad putra mugdha ceṣṭā vacas śraviṇe namaḥ om antar pracchanna vahni ābha dvija dāraka darśanāya namaḥ om tad māhātmya viśeṣa jñāya namaḥ om mauna mudrā vibhedakāya namaḥ om dvija dāraka saṃpraśna karaṇa udyata mānasāya namaḥ om tadīya jaḍa tā hetu pṛcchakāya namaḥ om karuṇākarāya namaḥ om bāla veṣa praticchanna tad ukti śravaṇa utsukāya namaḥ

original: oṃ dehādijaḍatābodhibālavākyātivismitāya namaḥ ||890|| oṃ svacetanatvasambodhitadvacaḥślāghanāparāya namaḥ | oṃ padyadvādaśikākartṛtatprajñāślāghanotsukāya namaḥ | oṃ tattvajñatāprakaṭataduktipratinandakāya namaḥ | oṃ adhyāpanādirahitabālaprajñātivismitāya namaḥ | oṃ tadanugrahaṇodyuktāya namaḥ | oṃ tanmūrdhanystahastakāya namaḥ |
analyzed: om deha ādi jaḍa tā bodhi bāla vākya ati vismitāya namaḥ om sva cetana tva sambodhi tad vacaḥ ślāghana aparāya namaḥ om padya dvādaśikā kartṛ tad prajñā ślāghana utsukāya namaḥ om tattva jña tā prakaṭa tad ukti pratinandakāya namaḥ om adhyāpana ādi rahita bāla prajñāti vismitāya namaḥ om tad anugrahaṇa udyuktāya namaḥ om tad mūrdhani sta hastakāya namaḥ

original: oṃ gṛhavāsādyayogyatvadarśakāya namaḥ | oṃ ślāghanāparāya namaḥ | oṃ dvijātipreṣaṇodyuktāya namaḥ | oṃ śiṣyasaṃgrahaṇodyuktāya namaḥ ||900|| oṃ hastāmalakasaṃjñāsandrātre namaḥ | oṃ nyāsadāyakāya namaḥ | oṃ svaśiṣyabhāvānugatahastāmalakasamśritāya namaḥ | oṃ śriṅgagiryākhyasukṣetragamanodyatamānasāya namaḥ | oṃ tuṅgabhadrākṛtasnānāya namaḥ |
analyzed: om gṛha vāsa ādi ayogya tva darśakāya namaḥ om ślāghanā parasmai namaḥ om dvijāti preṣaṇa udyuktāya namaḥ om śiṣya saṃgrahaṇa udyuktāya namaḥ om hasta āmalaka saṃjñā sandrātre namaḥ om nyāsa dāyakāya namaḥ om sva śiṣya bhāva anugata hasta āmalaka samśritāya namaḥ om śriṅga giri ākhya su kṣetra gamana udyata mānasāya namaḥ om tuṅgabhadrā kṛta snānāya namaḥ

original: oṃ bhāṣyapravacanotsukāya namaḥ | oṃ śāradālayanirmātre namaḥ | oṃ śāradāsthāpanāparāya namaḥ | oṃ śāradāpūjanodyuktāya namaḥ | oṃ śāradendusamānanāya namaḥ ||910|| oṃ giryākhyanijasacchiṣyaśuśrūṣāprītamānasāya namaḥ | oṃ pāṭhārthasamupāviṣṭaśiṣyamaṇḍalamaṇḍitāya namaḥ | oṃ svaśāṭīkṣālanodyuktagiryāgamananirīkṣakāya namaḥ |
analyzed: om bhāṣya pravacana utsukāya namaḥ om śārada ālaya nirmātre namaḥ om śārada āsthāpanā parasmai namaḥ om śāradā pūjana udyuktāya namaḥ om śārada indu sama ānanāya namaḥ om giri ākhya nija sat śiṣya śuśrūṣā prīta mānasāya namaḥ om pāṭha artha samupāviṣṭa śiṣya maṇḍala maṇḍitāya namaḥ om sva śāṭī kṣālana udyukta giri āgamana nirīkṣakāya namaḥ

original: oṃ nijaśiṣyāntarāsūyānirākaraṇatatparāya namaḥ | oṃ giryākhyanijasacchiṣyānugrahaikaparāyaṇāya namaḥ | oṃ svānugrahāptasarvajñabhāvagiryabhinanditāya namaḥ | oṃ viditākhilasadvidyāgiryabhivanditāya namaḥ | oṃ toṭakābhidasadvṛttojvalapadyāvakarṇakāya namaḥ | oṃ śiṣyāntarābhivijñātakaruṇāleśavaibhavāya namaḥ |
analyzed: om nija śiṣya antara asūyā nirākaraṇa tatparāya namaḥ om giri ākhya nija sat śiṣya anugraha eka parāyaṇāya namaḥ om sva anugraha āpta sarvajña bhāva giri abhinanditāya namaḥ om vidita akhila sat vidyā giri abhivanditāya namaḥ om toṭaka abhida sat vṛtta ujvala padya avakarṇakāya namaḥ om śiṣya antara abhivijñāta karuṇā leśa vaibhavāya namaḥ

original: oṃ gurvanugrahamāhātmyasandarśine namaḥ ||920|| oṃ lokasaṅgrahiṇe namaḥ | oṃ toṭakākhyāpradātre namaḥ | oṃ śrītoṭakāryātisatkṛtāya namaḥ | oṃ tatvārthagarbhatadvākyaśailīvaibhavacintakāya namaḥ | oṃ sureśvarāryapadmāṅghrihastāmalakasamśritāya namaḥ | oṃ toṭakānugatāya namaḥ | oṃ śiṣyacatuṣṭayasamāśritāya namaḥ |
analyzed: om guru anugraha māhātmya sandarśiṇe namaḥ om loka saṅgrahiṇe namaḥ om toṭaka ākhyā pradātre namaḥ om śrī toṭaka ārya ati satkṛtāya namaḥ om tatva artha garbha tad vākya śailī vaibhava cintakāya namaḥ om sureśvara ārya padma aṅghri hasta āmalaka samśritāya namaḥ om toṭaka anugatāya namaḥ om śiṣya catuṣṭaya samāśritāya namaḥ

original: oṃ sureśvarāpekṣitasvabhāṣyavārtikanirmitaye namaḥ | oṃ vārtikāracanānujñādātre namaḥ | oṃ deśikapuṅgavāya namaḥ ||930|| oṃ siddhāntāpagamāśaṅkipadmāṅghryādiprabodhitāya namaḥ | oṃ vārtikagraṃthanirmāṇajātavighnānudarśakāya namaḥ | oṃ śiṣyanirbandhānugāmine namaḥ | oṃ śiṣyaughakaruṇākarāya namaḥ |
analyzed: om sureśvara apekṣita sva bhāṣya vārtika nirmitaye namaḥ om vārttikā racanā anujñā dātre namaḥ om deśika puṅgavāya namaḥ om siddhānta apagama āśaṅki padmāṅghri ādi prabodhitāya namaḥ om vārttika grantha nirmāṇa jāta vighna anudarśakāya namaḥ om śiṣya nirbandha anugāmine namaḥ om śiṣya ogha karuṇā karāya namaḥ

original: oṃ padmāṅghriracitasvīyabhāṣyaṭīkānirīkṣakāya namaḥ | oṃ ramyanaiṣkarmyasiddhyādisureśagraṃthadarśakāya namaḥ | oṃ ādyantagraṃthasandarbhadarśanaprītamānasāya namaḥ | oṃ graṃthanirmāṇavaidagdhyadarśanādhikavismitāya namaḥ | oṃ taittarīyasvīyabhāṣyavṛttinirmāpaṇotsukāya namaḥ | oṃ bṛhadāraṇyasadbhāṣyavārtikaśravaṇādṛtāya namaḥ ||940||
analyzed: om padmāṅghri racita svīya bhāṣya ṭīkā nirīkṣakāya namaḥ om ramya naiṣkarmya siddhi ādi sureśa graṃtha darśakāya namaḥ om ādi anta graṃtha sandarbha darśana prīta mānasāya namaḥ om graṃtha nirmāṇa vaidagdhya darśana adhika vismitāya namaḥ om taittarīya svīya bhāṣya vṛtti nirmāpaṇa utsukāya namaḥ om bṛhadāraṇya sat bhāṣya vārtika śravaṇa ādṛtāya namaḥ

original: oṃ anekaśiṣyaracitādvaitagraṃthāvalokanāya namaḥ | oṃ tīrthayātrākṛtotsāhapadmapādokticintakāya namaḥ | oṃ tīrthayātrābhavānekadoṣasaṅghapradarśakāya namaḥ | oṃ nānāvikṣepasāhasrasambhavapratipādakāya namaḥ | oṃ tīrthayātraikanirbandhapadmapādānumodakāya namaḥ | oṃ svopadeśavaco'śrotṛpadmapādānuśocakāya namaḥ | oṃ mārgadoṣādisandarśine namaḥ |
analyzed: om aneka śiṣya racita advaita grantha avalokanāya namaḥ om tīrtha yātrā kṛta utsāha padma pāda ukti cintakāya namaḥ om tīrtha yātrā bhava aneka doṣa saṅgha pradarśakāya namaḥ om nānā vikṣepa sāhasra sambhava pratipādakāya namaḥ om tīrtha yātrā eka nirbandha padma pāda anumodakāya namaḥ om sva upadeśa vacaḥ śrotṛ padma pāda anuśocakāya namaḥ om mārga doṣa ādi sandarśine namaḥ

original: oṃ jāgarūkatvabodhakāya namaḥ | oṃ āsannamaraṇasvīyajananīsmaraṇāturāya namaḥ | oṃ smṛtimātrasamāpannamātṛpārśvāya namaḥ ||950|| oṃ atibhaktimate namaḥ | oṃ mātṛsandarśanaprītāya namaḥ | oṃ prīṇitasvīyamātṛkāya namaḥ | oṃ svasamskāraikasamprārthimātṛvāñchānupālakāya namaḥ | oṃ tārakākhyaparabrahmopadeṣṭre namaḥ | oṃ parameśvarāya namaḥ |
analyzed: om jāgarūka tva bodhakāya namaḥ om āsanna maraṇa svīya jananī smaraṇa āturāya namaḥ om smṛti mātra samāpanna mātṛ pārśvāya namaḥ om ati bhaktimate namaḥ om mātṛ sandarśana prītāya namaḥ om prīṇita svīya mātṛkāya namaḥ om sva samskāra eka samprārthi mātṛ vāñchā anupālakāya namaḥ om tāraka ākhya para brahma upadeṣṭre namaḥ om parameśvarāya namaḥ

original: oṃ brahmānabhijñajananīsantāraṇaparāyaṇāya namaḥ | oṃ nijastotrasamāyātaparameśapradarśakāya namaḥ | oṃ jananībhayasandraṣṭre namaḥ | oṃ mādhavastutitatparāya namaḥ ||960|| oṃ stutimāhātmyasamprāptaviṣṇumūrtipradarśakāya namaḥ | oṃ taddarśanasamutpannajananīprītibhājanāya namaḥ | oṃ viṣṇudūtavimānasthamātṛdarśanavirvṛtāya namaḥ |
analyzed: om brahma anabhijña jananī santāraṇa parāyaṇāya namaḥ om nija stotra samāyāta parameśa pradarśakāya namaḥ om jananī bhaya sandraṣṭre namaḥ om mādhava stuti tatparāya namaḥ om stuti māhātmya samprāpta viṣṇu mūrti pradarśakāya namaḥ om tad darśana samutpanna jananī prīti bhājanāya namaḥ om viṣṇu dūta vimāna stha mātṛ darśana virvṛtāya namaḥ

original: oṃ tatsamskārakṛtodyogāya namaḥ | oṃ bandhuvargasamāhvāyine namaḥ | oṃ samskārārthāgnisamprārthine namaḥ | oṃ bandhuvarganirākṛtāya namaḥ | oṃ dakṣadormathanaprāptavahnisamskṛtamātṛkāya namaḥ | oṃ āgnyadātṛsvīyajanavedabāhyatvaśāpakṛte namaḥ | oṃ yatibhikṣābhāvavācine namaḥ | oṃ smaśānīkṛtatadgṛhāya namaḥ | oṃ padmapādāgamakāṅkṣiṇe namaḥ |
analyzed: om tad samskāra kṛta udyogāya namaḥ om bandhu varga samāhvāyine namaḥ om samskāra artha agni samprārthine namaḥ om bandhu varga nirākṛtāya namaḥ om dakṣa dos mathana prāpta vahni samskṛta mātṛkāya namaḥ om ā agni adātṛ svīya jana veda bāhya tva śāpa kṛte namaḥ om yati bhikṣā bhāva vācine namaḥ om smaśānī kṛta tad gṛhāya namaḥ om padma pāda āgama kāṅkṣiṇe namaḥ

original: oṃ taddeśakṛtavāsakāya namaḥ | oṃ mahāsurālayeśānasandarśanaparāyaṇāya namaḥ | oṃ śiṣyavargāgamābhijñāya namaḥ | oṃ kuśalapraśnacodakāya namaḥ | oṃ padmāṅghribodhitasvīyasarvavṛttāntasamśraviṇe namaḥ | oṃ pūrvamātulasandagdhataṭṭīkoṭyanuśocakāya namaḥ | oṃ ṭīkālopātinirviṇṇapadmapādānunāyakāya namaḥ |
analyzed: om tad deśa kṛta vāsakāya namaḥ om mahā surālaya īśāna sandarśana parāyaṇāya namaḥ om śiṣya varga āgama abhijñāya namaḥ om kuśala praśna codakāya namaḥ om padma aṅghri bodhita svīya sarva vṛttānta samśraviṇe namaḥ om pūrva mātula sandagdha taṭṭī koṭi anuśocakāya namaḥ om ṭīkā lopa ati nirviṇṇa padma pāda anunāyakāya namaḥ

original: oṃ prajñāmāndyakarātyugragaradānoktisamśraviṇe namaḥ ||980|| oṃ nijapādābhipatitapadmapādānukampanāya namaḥ | oṃ pūrvasamśṛtaṭīkāsthapañcapādyanucintakāya namaḥ | oṃ pañcapādīyagatāśeṣaviṣayapratipādakāya namaḥ | oṃ ṭīkālekhanasantuṣṭapadmapādātipūjakāya namaḥ | oṃ vismitasvīyaśiṣaughasamabhiṣṭutavaibhavāya namaḥ |
analyzed: om namaḥ namaḥ namaḥ

original: oṃ nāṭakāpāyaduḥkhārtakeraleśasamādhikṛte namaḥ | oṃ yathoktanāṭakākhyānavismāpitanareśvarāya namaḥ | oṃ sudhanvarājasacchiṣyasahitāya namaḥ | oṃ vijayojvalāya namaḥ | oṃ rāmasetukṛtasnānāya namaḥ ||990|| oṃ śāktaughavijayotsāhāya namaḥ | oṃ kāñcīvidarbhakarṇātadeśasañcāranirvṛtāya namaḥ | oṃ kāpālikaughavijayine namaḥ |
analyzed: om nāṭaka apāya duḥkha ārta keraleśa samādhi kṛte namaḥ om yathā ukta nāṭaka ākhyāna vismāpita nareśvarāya namaḥ om sudhanva rāja sat śiṣya sahitāya namaḥ om vijaya ujvalāya namaḥ om rāmasetu kṛta snānāya namaḥ om śākta ogha vijaya utsāhāya namaḥ om kāñcī vidarbha karṇāta deśa sañcāra nirvṛtāya namaḥ om kāpālika ogha vijayine namaḥ

original: oṃ nīlakaṇṭhajayojvalāya namaḥ | oṃ guptābhicārābhijñapadmāṅghrikṛtasaukhyabhāje namaḥ | oṃ gauḍapādāryasandarśanānandābdhinimagnadhiye namaḥ | oṃ kāśmīradeśavilasacchāradāpīthadarśakāya namaḥ | oṃ dakṣiṇadvārasamviṣṭavādivrātajayojvalāya namaḥ | oṃ vijayaprāptasarvajñapīṭhārohaṇakautukine namaḥ |
analyzed: om nīlakaṇṭha jaya ujvalāya namaḥ om gupta abhicāra abhijña padma aṅghri kṛta saukhya bhāje namaḥ om gauḍa pāda ārya sandarśana ānanda abdhi nimagna dhiye namaḥ om kāśmīra deśa vilasat śāradā pītha darśakāya namaḥ om dakṣiṇa dvāra samviṣṭa vādi vrāta jaya ujvalāya namaḥ om vijaya prāpta sarvajña pīṭha ārohaṇa kautukine namaḥ

original: oṃ devatākṛtasatpuṣpavṛṣṭisañchannamūrtikāya namaḥ | oṃ kailāsaśailagamanaparamānandanirbharāya namaḥ | oṃ brahmādiracitāhvānāya namaḥ | oṃ śiṣyavargakṛtānataye namaḥ | oṃ mahokṣārohaṇodyuktāya namaḥ | oṃ padmajārpitahastakāya namaḥ | oṃ sarvābhilāṣakaraṇaniratāya namaḥ | oṃ nirvṛtāntarāya namaḥ |
analyzed: om devatā kṛta sat puṣpa vṛṣṭi sañchanna mūrtikāya namaḥ om kailāsa śaila gamana paramānanda nirbharāya namaḥ om brahma ādi racita āhvānāya namaḥ om śiṣya varga kṛta ānataye namaḥ om mahā ukṣa ārohaṇa udyuktāya namaḥ om padmaja arpita hastakāya namaḥ om sarva abhilāṣa karaṇa niratāya namaḥ om nirvṛta antarāya namaḥ

original: oṃ śrī kailāsaśailagamanaparamānandanirbharāya namaḥ | oṃ śrīmatsadguruparaprahmaṇe namaḥ ||oṃ|| ||1008||
analyzed: om śrī kailāsa śaila gamana paramānanda nirbharāya namaḥ om śrīmat sat guru para prahmaṇe namaḥ om

original: antardhvāntanivāraṇaikataraṇistāpatrayogrānala jvālāttyantikaśāmanaikajalado duḥkhāmbudherbāḍavaḥ | prajñānandasudhāmbuderudayabhāgrākāsudhādīdhitiḥ nityaṃ śaṅkaradeśikendrayatirāṭ hṛdvyomni vidyotatām ||
analyzed: antar dhvānta nivāraṇa eka taraṇiḥ tāpa traya ugra anala jvālā āttyantika śāmana eka jaladaḥ duḥkha ambudheḥ bāḍavaḥ prajñā ānanda sudhā ambudeḥ udaya bhā grākā sudhā dīdhitiḥ nityam śaṅkara deśika indra yati rāj hṛd vyomni vidyotatām

original: bhaktajanahṛttimirakartanavikartanān dvandvamukhaduḥkhaviṣasarpagaruḍottamān | janmamṛtidurgatimahārṇavaghaṭodbhavān śaṅkaragurūttamapadān namata sattamān ||
analyzed: bhakta jana hṛd timira kartana vikartanān dvandva mukha duḥkha viṣa sarpa garuḍa uttamān janma mṛti durgati mahā arṇava ghaṭa udbhavān śaṅkara guru uttama padān namata sattamān

original: jaya jaya śaṅkara | oṃ śrī lalitā mahātripurasundarī parābhaṭṭārikā sametāya śrī candramaulīśvara parabrahmaṇe namaḥ |
analyzed: jaya jaya śaṅkara om śrī lalitā mahā tripurasundarī parā bhaṭṭārikā sametāya śrī candramauli īśvara para brahmaṇe namaḥ
